parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the IP.Interface. table, or the Path Name of an interface layered above such a row, e.g., a row in the Logical.Interface. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. The IP Interface associated with the Server entry.

parameters.name: BindType
parameters.desc: Specifies how the client sockets must be bounded. Enumeration of: Address (The server sockets are bound to a local IP address) Device (The server sockets are bound to a network device. This can be useful when the local address is dynamic)

parameters.name: MinPoll
parameters.desc: This is the minimum polling interval, in seconds to the power of two, allowed by any peer of the Internet system, currently set to 6 (64 seconds). [ Section 7.2/RFC5905 ]

parameters.name: MaxPoll
parameters.desc: This is the maximum polling interval, in seconds to the power of two, allowed by any peer of the Internet system, currently set to 10 (1024 seconds) [ Section 7.2/RFC5905 ]

parameters.name: TTL
parameters.desc: Specifies the time to live (TTL) for a broadcast/multicast packet. [ Section 3.1/RFC5905 ]

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables authentication of the NTP server.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.Certificate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Points to the certificate that must be used by the NTS-KE client.

parameters.name: NTSNTPServer
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Points to a CSV list of NTP servers. A NTP server can either be specified as an IP address or a host name. When used the NTS-KE server will tell the remote NTS-KE client the NTP hostname or address of the NTP server(s) that should be used. This allows to separate the NTP server and NTS-KE server implementation.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully sent from the NTP server to the NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsSentFailed
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Specifies the number of packets that were not successfully sent to the NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully received by the NTP server from a NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsDropped
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Specifies the number of packets that were received by the NTP server but were not successfully processed or handled due to errors or other issues.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables and disables the CPE's user interface. The factory default value MUST be true .

parameters.name: PasswordRequired
parameters.desc: Present only if the CPE provides a password-protected LAN-side user interface. Indicates whether or not the local user interface MUST require a password to be chosen by the user. If false , the choice of whether or not a password is used is left to the user.

parameters.name: PasswordUserSelectable
parameters.desc: Present only if the CPE provides a password-protected LAN-side user interface and supports LAN-side Auto-Configuration. Indicates whether or not a password to protect the local user interface of the CPE MAY be selected by the user directly (i.e. Users.User.{i}.Password ), or MUST be equal to the password used by the LAN-side Auto-Configuration protocol (i.e. LANConfigSecurity.ConfigPassword ).

parameters.name: UpgradeAvailable
parameters.desc: Indicates that a CPE upgrade is available, allowing the CPE to display this information to the user.

parameters.name: WarrantyDate
parameters.desc: Indicates the date and time in UTC that the warranty associated with the CPE is to expire.

parameters.name: ISPName
parameters.desc: The name of the customer's ISP.

parameters.name: ISPHelpDesk
parameters.desc: The help desk phone number of the ISP.

parameters.name: ISPHomePage
parameters.desc: The [ URL ] of the ISP's home page.

parameters.name: ISPHelpPage
parameters.desc: The [ URL ] of the ISP's on-line support page.

parameters.name: ISPLogo
parameters.desc: Base64 encoded GIF or JPEG image. The binary image is constrained to 4095 bytes or less.

parameters.name: ISPLogoSize
parameters.desc: Un-encoded binary image size in bytes. If ISPLogoSize input value is 0 then the ISPLogo is cleared. ISPLogoSize can also be used as a check to verify correct transfer and conversion of Base64 string to image size.

parameters.name: ISPMailServer
parameters.desc: The [ URL ] of the ISP's mail server.

parameters.name: ISPNewsServer
parameters.desc: The [ URL ] of the ISP's news server.

parameters.name: TextColor
parameters.desc: The color of text on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.desc: The color of the GUI screen backgrounds in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: ButtonColor
parameters.desc: The color of buttons on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: ButtonTextColor
parameters.desc: The color of text on buttons on the GUI screens in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: AutoUpdateServer
parameters.desc: The server the CPE can check to see if an update is available for direct download to it.

parameters.name: UserUpdateServer
parameters.desc: The server where a user can check via a web browser if an update is available for download to a PC.

parameters.name: AvailableLanguages
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 256) of strings. List items represent user-interface languages that are available, where each language is specified according to [ RFC3066 ].

parameters.name: CurrentLanguage
parameters.desc: Current user-interface language, specified according to [ RFC3066 ]. The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the AvailableLanguages parameter.

parameters.name: HTTPAccessSupportedProtocols
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Indicates the protocols that are supported by the CPE for the purpose of remotely accessing the user interface. Each list item is an enumeration of: HTTP (As defined in [ RFC9110 ]) HTTPS (As defined in [ RFC9110 ])

parameters.name: HTTPAccessNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the HTTPAccess table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables/disables web interface.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on crea...

parameters.name: Order
parameters.desc: [ Order ] Position of the HTTPAccess entry in the order of precedence. A value of 1 indicates the first entry to be considered (highest precedence). When a HTTPAccess instance is created, or when an existing Order value is modified, if the value matches that of an existing entry, the Order values for the existing entry and all lower Order entries are incremented (lowered in precedence) to ensure uniqueness of this value. A deletion causes Order values to be compacted. When a value is changed,...

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: Status of web interface. Enumeration of: Up (Indicates that the web interface is enabled and working) Down (Indicates that the web interface is disabled and thus not working) Error (MAY be used by the web interface to indicate a locally defined error condition, OPTIONAL)

parameters.name: AccessType
parameters.desc: This parameter describes the possible access types. Enumeration of: RemoteAccess (Indicates that the web interface should be used for remote access. Remote access is defined as any entity not on a local subnet attempting to connect to the device) LocalAccess (Indicates that the web interface should be used for local access)

parameters.name: AllowedRoles
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings (maximum number of characters per item 256). Each list item MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Users.Role. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the corresponding item MUST be removed from the list. Only allow users, defined in Users.User. , to access the web instance represented by this HTTPAccess instance that have the following roles assigned that are defined in Users.Role. .

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.Certificate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the server certificate to be presented by the server during the TLS handshake. This certificate is used to authenticate the server to remote clients, ensuring that the clients are connecting to a legitimate server. The server certificate must be issued by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA) and should match the server'...

parameters.name: CABundle
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.CABundle. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the group of CA certificate(s) that the server must use to validate the certificate presented by the remote client. These CA certificates form a trust chain that the client certificate must match, ensuring that only clients with trusted certificates can establish a connection. This parameter supports multiple CA certificat...

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a table row. The IP or Logical Interface associated with the HTTPAccess entry. Example: Device.IP.Interface.1 Device.Logical.Interface.1 If the value is an empty string, the CPE MUST use its routing policy (IP Forwarding table entries), if necessary, to determine the appropriate interface.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.desc: Listen port number.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the HTTPAccessSupportedProtocols parameter. Protocol being used.

parameters.name: AllowedHosts
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Specifies which hostnames are permitted to be served by the web interface. This could be done by comparing the Host: HTTP header in an incoming request which will result in the request being routed to this instance, in the case that the device supports Virtual Hosting. If this string is empty then this instance acts as a "default" host, i.e. it will handle requests for which the Host header does not match any other instance.

parameters.name: AllowedPathPrefixes
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each string must be a partial path which will result in an incoming request being routed to this instance.

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv4
parameters.desc: Allow incoming IP connections from any IPv4 address. The source prefixes defined in IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Allow only incoming IP connections from the provided list of IPv4 prefixes. When IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix is set to an empty string and AllowAllIPv4 is set to false , no incoming IP connections are allowed. When AllowAllIPv4 is set true , IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix is ignored.

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv6
parameters.desc: Allow incoming IP connections from any IPv6 address. The source prefixes defined in IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Allow only incoming IP connections from the provided list of IPv6 prefixes. When IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix is set to an empty string and AllowAllIPv6 is set to false , no incoming IP connections are allowed. When AllowAllIPv6 is set true , IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix is ignored.

parameters.name: AutoDisableDuration
parameters.desc: Indicates in seconds when the web interface will be automatically disabled. When 0 is specified, the web interface will not be automatically disabled. For example if the web interface is to be active for only 30 minutes, then this parameter would be set to 1800 seconds .

parameters.name: TimeLeft
parameters.desc: The number of seconds remaining before the web interface will be disabled. 0 means that the web interface is disabled or no AutoDisableDuration was specified. Example: The AutoDisableDuration parameter has been set to 1800 seconds and the web interface was enabled 600 seconds ago. This means that the TimeLeft will return 1200 seconds, which is the remaining time before the web interface will be disabled. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ActivationDate
parameters.desc: Indicates when the web interface was enabled.

parameters.name: SessionNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Session table.

parameters.name: SessionID
parameters.desc: Session identifier. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: User
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Users.User. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. The user to whom the session belongs. When the user is unknown an empty string string SHOULD be used. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.17 version.

parameters.name: IPAddress
parameters.desc: [ IPAddress ] The IP address of the remote web client, connected to the web interface.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.desc: Port number of the remote web client, connected to the web interface.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the HTTPAccessSupportedProtocols parameter. Protocol being used.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.desc: Indicates when the session was created.

parameters.name: Movable
parameters.desc: Controls whether the user is allowed to change the GUI window position on the local CPE's display.

parameters.name: Resizable
parameters.desc: Controls whether the user is allowed to resize the GUI window on the local CPE's display.

parameters.name: PosX
parameters.desc: The horizontal position of the User Interface's top left corner within the local CPE's display measured from the top left corner, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: PosY
parameters.desc: The vertical position of the User Interface's top left corner within the local CPE's display measured from the top left corner, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: Width
parameters.desc: The width of the user interface within the local CPE's display, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: Height
parameters.desc: The height of the user interface within the local CPE's display, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: DisplayWidth
parameters.desc: The width of the local CPE's display, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: DisplayHeight
parameters.desc: The height of the local CPE's display, expressed in pixels .

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables and displays the user information message. The factory default value MUST be true .

parameters.name: Title
parameters.desc: Message title to be displayed.

parameters.name: SubTitle
parameters.desc: Message sub title to be displayed.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.desc: Message text.

parameters.name: IconType
parameters.desc: Icon to be displayed. Enumeration of: None Greeting Information Warning Important Urgent Advertisement

parameters.name: MessageColor
parameters.desc: The color of message text in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: BackgroundColor
parameters.desc: The color of the message screen background in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: TitleColor
parameters.desc: The color of the message title in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: SubTitleColor
parameters.desc: The color of the sub title in RGB hexadecimal notation (e.g., FF0088).

parameters.name: RequestedNumberOfRepetitions
parameters.desc: The number of times the device SHOULD repeat the message.

parameters.name: ExecutedNumberOfRepetitions
parameters.desc: The number of times the device repeated the message.

parameters.name: SFPCageNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the SFPCage table.

parameters.name: SupportedSFPTypes
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Indicates the SFP types supported by the CPE. Each list item is an enumeration of: G-PON XG-PON NG-PON2 XGS-PON EPON MoCA Optical Ethernet Electrical Ethernet

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The internal name used to identify the SFP Cage instance. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: SFPPresent
parameters.desc: The value true indicates the presence of an SFP in the SFP Cage instance. The value is always true for a SFF. Note: A value of 0x02 in SFF8024Identifier will also indicate the presence of an SFF.

parameters.name: SFF8024Identifier
parameters.desc: This identifier describes the type of SFP and the management protocol as per "Identifier Value" listed in [ Table 4-1/SFF-8024 ].

parameters.name: MgmtInterface
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the management interface used by the SFP. Refer [ Table 4-1/SFF-8024 ] and [ SFF-8472 ]. Enumeration of: SFF-8472 (SFF 8472) Unknown (Unknown Mgmt Interface)

parameters.name: SFPType
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the SupportedSFPTypes parameter, or else be Unsupported. This value is applicable only when SFPPresent is true . If the SFP Type cannot be classified, the value is reported as "Unsupported".

parameters.name: SFPReference
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the SFPs.Mgmt.SFF8472. table. The path to the SFP management object associated with this interface.

parameters.name: IsAllowed
parameters.desc: true if the CPE allows the SFP, false if the CPE blocks the SFP. See AllowedSFPs for what it means for an SFP to be blocked or allowed. The CPE sets this parameter to true or false based on the configuration in: AllowedSFPs.AllowAllSFPs AllowedSFPs.AllowedSFP This parameter is only applicable for pluggable SFPs; it's not applicable for built-in modules/SFPs (the CPE should always allow built-in modules/SFPs). This parameter is also only applicable if SFPPresent is true .

parameters.name: SFF8472NumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the SFF8472 table.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The internal name used to identify this SFP instance. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Connector
parameters.desc: The connector value as per [ Table 4-3/SFF-8024 ] indicates the external optical or electrical cable connector provided as the media interface.

parameters.name: Transceiver
parameters.desc: This field contains code for electronic or optical compatibility as per [ Table 5-3/SFF-8472 ] and [ Table 4-4/SFF-8024 ]. It corresponds to the values of DMM address 0xA0, bytes 3-10 and 36. The associated bit significant indicators (as identified in the above referenced tables) define the electronic or optical interfaces that are supported by the transceiver. At least one bit will be set in this field.

parameters.name: Encoding
parameters.desc: This contains the code for high speed serial encoding algorithm as per [ Table 4-2/SFF-8024 ].

parameters.name: BRNominal
parameters.desc: This field contains the Nominal bit signaling rate, in units of 100 MBd as per [ Section 5-6/SFF-8472 ]. The bit rate includes those bits necessary to encode and delimit the signal as well as those bits carrying data information. A value of 0 indicates that the bit rate is not specified and must be determined from the transceiver technology. If the value is 255 (indicating 25.4GBd) then BRMax contains rate in units of 250MBd.

parameters.name: RateIdentifier
parameters.desc: The rate identifier byte as per [ Table 5-6/SFF-8472 ] refers to several (optional) industry standard definitions of Rate_Select or Application_Select control behaviors, intended to manage transceiver optimization for multiple operating rates.

parameters.name: VendorName
parameters.desc: The vendor name is a string of ASCII characters. It is the full name of the corporation, a commonly accepted abbreviation of the name of the corporation, the SCSI company code for the corporation, or the stock exchange code for the corporation. At least one of VendorName or VendorOUI shall contain valid data.

parameters.name: VendorOUI
parameters.desc: The vendor organizationally unique identifier field (vendor OUI) is a string that contains the IEEE Company Identifier for the vendor. An empty value indicates that the vendor OUI is unspecified.

parameters.name: VendorPN
parameters.desc: The vendor part number provided by Transceiver vendor is a string of maximum 16 ASCII characters. An empty string indicates that the vendor PN is unspecified.

parameters.name: VendorRev
parameters.desc: The vendor revision number provided by Transceiver vendor is a string of maximum 4 ASCII characters. An empty string indicates that the vendor revision is unspecified.

parameters.name: BRMax
parameters.desc: This is the upper bit rate margin in units of 1%, within which the transceiver will still meet its specifications (BR, max) is specified in units of 1% above the nominal bit rate. A value of zero indicates that this field is not specified. However this field may contain the nominal bit rate in units of 250MBd if the value in BRNominal is 255. See [ Section 8.4/SFF-8472 ] - Address 0xA0, Byte 66.

parameters.name: BRMin
parameters.desc: This is the lower bit rate margin in units of percent , within which the transceiver will still meet its specifications (BR, min) is specified in units of 1 percent below the nominal bit rate. A value of zero indicates that this field is not specified. However this field may also specify range of signaling rates specified in units of +/- 1 percent around the nominal signaling rate. See [ Section 8.5/SFF-8472 ] - Address 0xA0, Byte 67.

parameters.name: VendorSN
parameters.desc: The serial number provided by the Transceiver vendor is a string of maximum 16 ASCII characters. An empty string indicates that the vendor SN is unspecified.

parameters.name: DateCode
parameters.desc: The transceiver vendor date code. The format is YYMMDDLL where YY - year (00 = 2000), MM - month (01 = January), DD - day (01 to 31), LL - optional vendor lot code. Possible patterns: \d{2}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])[A-Za-z0-9]{0,2}

parameters.name: LengthSMFkm
parameters.desc: This value specifies the link length in kilometers that is supported by the transceiver while operating in compliance with the applicable standards using single mode fiber. The value is in units of kilometers. A value of 255 means that the transceiver supports a link length greater than 254 km. A value of zero means that the transceiver does not support single mode fiber or that the length information must be determined from the transceiver technology.

parameters.name: LengthSMF
parameters.desc: This value specifies the link length that is supported by the transceiver while operating in compliance with the applicable standards using single-mode fiber. The value is in units of 100 meters . A value of 255 means that the transceiver supports a link length greater than 25.4 km. A value of zero means that the transceiver does not support single-mode fiber or that the length information must be determined from the transceiver technology.

parameters.name: LengthOM2
parameters.desc: This value specifies link length that is supported by the transceiver while operating in compliance with applicable standards using 50 micron multimode OM2 [500MHz*km at 850nm,] fiber. The value is in units of 10 meters . A value of 255 means that the transceiver supports a link length greater than 2.54 km. A value of zero means that the transceiver does not support 50 micron multimode OM2 fiber or that the length information must be determined from the transceiver technology.

parameters.name: LengthOM1
parameters.desc: This value specifies link length that is supported by the transceiver while operating in compliance with applicable standards using 62.5 micron multimode OM1 [200 MHz km at 850nm, 500 MHz km at 1310nm] fiber. The value is in units of 10 meters . A value of 255 means that the transceiver supports a link length greater than 2.54 km. A value of zero means that the transceiver does not support 62.5 micron multimode fiber or that the length information must be determined from the transceiver techn...

parameters.name: LengthOM3
parameters.desc: This value specifies link length that is supported by the transceiver while operating in compliance with applicable standards using 50 micron multimode OM3 [2000 MHz*km] fiber. The value is in units of 10 meters . A value of 255 means that the transceiver supports a link length greater than 2.54 km. A value of zero means that the transceiver does not support 50 micron multimode OM3 fiber or that the length information must be determined from the transceiver technology.

parameters.name: Wavelength
parameters.desc: This value denotes the nominal transmitter output wavelength at room temperature measured in nanometers . This field allows the user to read the laser wavelength directly, so it is not necessary to infer it from the transceiver “Code for Electronic Compatibility”. This also allows specification of wavelengths not covered in those fields, such as those used in coarse WDM systems.

parameters.name: VerCompliance
parameters.desc: The value indicates which revision of SFF requirements the transceiver complies with. See [ Table 8-8/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptCooledTrans
parameters.desc: A value of false identifies a conventional uncooled (or unspecified) laser implementation. A value of true identifies a cooled laser transmitter implementation. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptPowerlvl
parameters.desc: A value of false identifies Power Level 1 (or unspecified) requirements. A value of true identifies Power Level 2 requirement. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptLinearRcvr
parameters.desc: A value of false identifies a conventional limiting (or unspecified) receiver output. A value of true identifies a linear receiver output. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptRateSelect
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that the optional RATE_SELECT functionality is implemented. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptTxDisable
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that the optional TX_DISABLE functionality is implemented. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptTxFault
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that the optional Tx Fault monitoring is implemented. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptInvertedLOS
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that Loss of Signal implemented with signal inverted from standard definition in SFP MSA (called “Signal Detect”) as per [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: OptLOS
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that this optional transceiver signal for Loss of signal is implemented. See [ Table 8-3/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: DMCtypeImplemented
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that Digital Diagnostic monitoring is implemented. See [ Section 8-8/SFF-8472 ]. If set to true , received power monitoring, transmitted power monitoring, bias current monitoring, supply voltage monitoring and temperature monitoring are all implemented.

parameters.name: DMCtypeInternalCal
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that transceiver is Internally calibrated. The transceiver directly reports calibrated values in units of current, power etc.

parameters.name: DMCtypeExternalCal
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that transceiver is Externally calibrated. The reported values are A/D counts which must be converted to real world units using calibration values read using additional information from the SFP memory.

parameters.name: DMCtypeRxAvgPwr
parameters.desc: This value indicates the Received power measurement type. If true , average received power is monitored. If false , OMA is monitored.

parameters.name: EOCalarmsImplemented
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that Alarms/Warnings flags for monitored quantities are implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EOCSoftTxDisable
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that Soft TX_DISABLE control and monitoring is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EOCSoftTxFault
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that soft TX_FAULT monitoring is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EOCSoftRxLOS
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that soft RX_LOS is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EOCSoftRateSelect
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that this soft Rate Select and Control is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: SFF8079AppSelect
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that application rate select feature is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: SFF8431SoftRateSelect
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates that Soft Rate Select as per SFF-8431 is implemented in the transceiver. See [ Table 8-6/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EMCSPowerLvlOp
parameters.desc: A value of true indicates Power Level Operation control and status is implemented in transceiver. See [ Table 10-1/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: EMCSPowerLvlSelect
parameters.desc: A value of true enables selection of power level to transmit. See [ Table 10-1/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: HighTempAlarm
parameters.desc: Temperature, measured in degrees celsius , at which a high temperature alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighTempWarning
parameters.desc: Temperature, measured in degrees celsius , at which a high temperature warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTempWarning
parameters.desc: Temperature, measured in degrees celsius , below which a low temperature warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTempAlarm
parameters.desc: Temperature, measured in degrees celsius , below which a low temperature alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighVccAlarm
parameters.desc: Voltage, measured in mV , above which a high Vcc alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighVccWarning
parameters.desc: Voltage, measured in mV , above which a high Vcc warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowVccWarning
parameters.desc: Voltage, measured in mV , below which a low Vcc warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowVccAlarm
parameters.desc: Voltage, measured in mV , below which a low Vcc alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighTxBiasAlarm
parameters.desc: Tx Bias, current measured in µA , above which a High Tx Bias alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighTxBiasWarning
parameters.desc: Tx Bias, current measured in µA , above which a High Tx Bias warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTxBiasWarning
parameters.desc: Tx Bias, current measured in µA , below which a Low Tx Bias warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTxBiasAlarm
parameters.desc: Tx Bias, current measured in µA , below which a Low Tx Bias alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighTxPowerAlarm
parameters.desc: Tx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , above which a High Tx Power alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighTxPowerWarning
parameters.desc: Tx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , above which a High Tx Power warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTxPowerWarning
parameters.desc: Tx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , below which a Low Tx Power warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowTxPowerAlarm
parameters.desc: Tx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , below which a Low Tx Power alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighRxPowerAlarm
parameters.desc: Rx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , above which a High Rx Power alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: HighRxPowerWarning
parameters.desc: Rx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , above which a High Rx Power warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowRxPowerWarning
parameters.desc: Rx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , below which a Low Rx Power warning will be triggered.

parameters.name: LowRxPowerAlarm
parameters.desc: Rx Power, measured in 0.1 dBm , below which a Low Rx Power alarm will be triggered.

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.desc: Internally measured module temperature measured in degrees celsius . See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ]. A value of -274 indicates that a good reading could not be obtained.

parameters.name: Vcc
parameters.desc: Internally measured supply voltage in transceiver measured in mV . See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: TxBias
parameters.desc: Internally measured TX Bias Current measured in µA . See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: TxPower
parameters.desc: Measured TX output power measured in 0.1 dBm . See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: RxPower
parameters.desc: Measured RX input power measured in 0.1 dBm . See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: TxDisableState
parameters.desc: The digital state of the TX Disable Input Pin. Updated within 100ms of change on pin. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: SoftTxDisableSelect
parameters.desc: This optional status control bit allows software disable of laser. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ]. Setting this flag true disables the laser. If Soft TX Disable is not implemented, the transceiver ignores the value of this bit. Default power up value is zero/low.

parameters.name: RS1State
parameters.desc: An optional digital state of SFP input pin AS(1) per [ SFF-8079 ] or RS(1) per [ SFF-8431 ]. Updated within 100ms of change on pin. See 0xA2 Byte 118, Bit 3 for Soft RS(1) Select control information. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: RateSelectState
parameters.desc: An optional digital state of SFP input pin AS(0) Rate_Select State [aka. “RS(0)”]. Updated within 100ms of change on pin. Note: This pin is also known as AS(0) in [ SFF-8079 ] and RS(0) in [ SFF-8431 ]. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: SoftRateSelectSelect
parameters.desc: Soft Rate_Select Select (aka. “RS(0)”). An optional Status or Control Bit. This flag allows software rate select control. Setting this flag true selects full bandwidth operation. This bit is logical OR with the hard Rate_Select, AS(0) or RS(0) pin value. Default at power up is logic zero/low. If Soft Rate Select is not implemented, the transceiver ignores the value of this bit. Note: Specific transceiver behaviors of this bit are identified in referenced documents. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: TXFaultState
parameters.desc: An optional digital state of the TX Fault Output Pin. Updated within 100ms of change on pin. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: RxLOSState
parameters.desc: An optional digital state of the RX_LOS Output Pin. Updated within 100ms of change on pin.

parameters.name: DataReadyBarState
parameters.desc: An optional flag that indicates the transceiver has achieved power up and data is ready. The flag remains high until data is ready to be read at which time the device sets the bit low. The default value SHOULD be false. See [ Table 9-16/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: TemperatureHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal temperature exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TemperatureLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal temperature is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: VccHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal supply voltage exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: VccLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal supply voltage is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: TxBiasHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX Bias current exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TxBiasLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX Bias current is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: TxPowerHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX output power exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: TxPowerLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX output power is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: RxPowerHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the Received Power exceeds the high alarm level.

parameters.name: RxPowerLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the Received Power is below the low alarm level.

parameters.name: TemperatureHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal temperature exceeds the high warning level.

parameters.name: TemperatureLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal temperature is below the low warning level.

parameters.name: VccHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal supply voltage exceeds the high warning level.

parameters.name: VccLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the internal supply voltage is below the low warning level.

parameters.name: TxBiasHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX Bias current exceeds the high warning level.

parameters.name: TxBiasLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX Bias current is below the low warning level.

parameters.name: TxPowerHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX output power exceeds the high warning level.

parameters.name: TxPowerLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the TX output power is below the low warning level.

parameters.name: RxPowerHigh
parameters.desc: Set to true when the Received Power exceeds the high warning level.

parameters.name: RxPowerLow
parameters.desc: Set to true when the Received Power is below the low warning level.

parameters.name: SFPNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the SFP table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables this entry.

parameters.name: VendorName
parameters.desc: The vendor name of the SFP. When empty, the vendor name is not used in determining the SFP type. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with VendorOUI and VendorPN ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: VendorOUI
parameters.desc: The vendor organizationally unique identifier (OUI) field of the SFP. When empty, the vendor OUI is not used in determining the SFP type. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with VendorName and VendorPN ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: VendorPN
parameters.desc: The vendor part number (PN) of the SFP. When empty, the vendor PN is not used in determining the SFP type. The ASCII character * is interpreted as a wildcard character. Note: the string "*" as value for this parameter is equivalent to the empty string as value for this parameter. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with VendorName , VendorOUI ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: SFPType
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the SupportedSFPTypes parameter. It has the same allowed values as SFPCage.{i}.SFPType , except for "Unsupported".

parameters.name: AllowedSFPNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the AllowedSFP table.

parameters.name: AllowAllSFPs
parameters.desc: When set to true , the CPE allows all SFPs and the configuration in AllowedSFP is ignored. When set to false , the CPE only allows SFPs which match with the classification criteria of at least one entry in AllowedSFP . The CPE blocks each SFP for which there is no match. The default value SHOULD be true .

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on crea...

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables this entry. If true , the CPE should allow the SFPs which match this entry. If false , the CPE should not use this entry to determine if an SFP is allowed or not.

parameters.name: SFPType
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the SupportedSFPTypes parameter, or else be an empty string. Classification criterion. When empty, the SFP is not classified by SFP type.

parameters.name: VendorName
parameters.desc: Classification criterion. When empty, the SFP is not classified by vendor name.

parameters.name: VendorOUI
parameters.desc: Classification criterion. The vendor organizationally unique identifier (OUI) field of the SFP. When empty, the SFP is not classified by vendor OUI.

parameters.name: VendorPN
parameters.desc: Classification criterion. The vendor part number (PN) of the SFP. The ASCII character * is interpreted as a wildcard character. The * wildcard may be used to match any value, either fully (e.g., * ) or partially (e.g., F* or *3 ). When empty or equal to "*", the SFP is not classified by vendor PN. Note: the string "*" as value for this parameter is equivalent to the empty string as value for this parameter.

parameters.name: Fingerprint
parameters.desc: Classification criterion. Fingerprint over certain properties of the SFP. If non-empty, the CPE must take this fingerprint into account when classifying the SFP. Sometimes the other classification criteria in this AllowedSFP do not suffice to classify an SFP (to determine whether the SFP should be blocked or allowed). Then a CPE can use a fingerprint/CRC/hash calculated over other properties of the SFP as extra discriminator. E.g. it could calculate a hash over the calibration data. Example: ...

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: HigherLayer
parameters.desc: A reference to the interface object corresponding to the higher layer of the relationship, i.e. the interface which runs on top of the interface identified by the corresponding instance of LowerLayer . When the referenced higher layer interface is deleted, the CPE MUST delete the table row.

parameters.name: LowerLayer
parameters.desc: A reference to the interface object corresponding to the lower layer of the relationship, i.e. the interface which runs below the interface identified by the corresponding instance of HigherLayer . When the referenced lower layer interface is deleted, the CPE MUST delete the table row.

parameters.name: HigherAlias
parameters.desc: The value of the Alias parameter for the interface object referenced by HigherLayer .

parameters.name: LowerAlias
parameters.desc: The value of the Alias parameter for the interface object referenced by LowerLayer .

parameters.name: LineNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Line table.

parameters.name: ChannelNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Channel table.

parameters.name: BondingGroupNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the BondingGroup table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables the interface. This parameter is based on ifAdminStatus from [ RFC2863 ].

parameters.name: EnableDataGathering
parameters.desc: Enables or disables data gathering on the DSL line.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: The current operational state of the interface (see [ Section 4.2.2/TR-181i2 ]). Enumeration of: Up Down Unknown Dormant NotPresent LowerLayerDown Error (OPTIONAL) When Enable is false then Status SHOULD normally be Down (or NotPresent or Error if there is a fault condition on the interface). When Enable is changed to true then Status SHOULD change to Up if and only if the interface is able to transmit and receive network traffic; it SHOULD change to Dormant if and only if the interface is op...

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The textual name of the interface as assigned by the CPE. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.desc: A user-friendly description of the interface.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.desc: The accumulated time in seconds since the interface entered its current operational state. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: LowerLayers
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Each list item MUST be the Path Name of an interface object that is stacked immediately below this interface object, or an empty string. See [ Section 4.2.1/TR-181i2 ]. Note: Since Line is a layer 1 interface, it is expected that LowerLayers will not be used.

parameters.name: Upstream
parameters.desc: Indicates whether the interface points towards the Internet ( true ) or towards End Devices ( false ). The upstream interface is the one that provides connectivity to the Internet or the next hop router. For example: For an Internet Gateway Device, Upstream will be true for all WAN interfaces and false for all LAN interfaces. For a standalone WiFi Access Point that is connected via Ethernet to an Internet Gateway Device, Upstream will be true for the Ethernet interface and false for the WiFi ...

parameters.name: FirmwareVersion
parameters.desc: A string identifying the version of the modem firmware currently installed for this interface. This is applicable only when the modem firmware is separable from the overall CPE software.

parameters.name: LinkStatus
parameters.desc: Status of the DSL physical link. Enumeration of: Up Initializing EstablishingLink NoSignal Disabled Error (OPTIONAL) When LinkStatus is Up , Status is expected to be Up . When LinkStatus is Initializing or EstablishingLink or NoSignal or Disabled , Status is expected to be Down . The Error value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: XTSE
parameters.desc: This configuration parameter defines the transmission system types to be allowed by the xTU on this Line instance. Each bit is 0 if not allowed or 1 if allowed, as defined for the xTU transmission system enabling (XTSE) in ITU-T G.997.1. Note: This parameter is defined as xDSL Transmission system enabling (XTSE) in ITU-T G.997.1. For a full definition, see Clause 7.3.1.1.1 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: XTSUsed
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates which DSL standard and recommendation are currently in use by the Line instance. Only one bit is set, as defined for the xTU transmission system enabling (XTSE) in ITU-T G.997.1.

parameters.name: LineEncoding
parameters.desc: The line encoding method used in establishing the Layer 1 DSL connection between the CPE and the DSLAM. Enumeration of: DMT CAP 2B1Q 43BT PAM QAM Note: Generally speaking, this variable does not change after provisioning.

parameters.name: AllowedProfiles
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. List items indicate which VDSL2 profiles are allowed on the line. Each list item is an enumeration of: 8a 8b 8c 8d 12a 12b 17a 17b (This enumeration was DELETED in 2.12 because the value is not defined in G997.1) 30a 35b Note: In G.997.1, this parameter is called PROFILES. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. Note: This parameter is OPTIONAL at the G and S/T interfaces in G.997.1 Amendment 1. If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its valu...

parameters.name: CurrentProfile
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the AllowedProfiles parameter, or else be an empty string. Indicates which VDSL2 profile is currently in use on the line. Note: This parameter is OPTIONAL at the G and S/T interfaces in G.997.1 Amendment 1. If the parameter is implemented but no value is available, its value MUST be an empty string.

parameters.name: PowerManagementState
parameters.desc: The power management state of the line. Enumeration of: L0 L1 L2 L3 L4 Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: SuccessFailureCause
parameters.desc: The success failure cause of the initialization. An enumeration of the following integer values: 0: Successful 1: Configuration error. This error occurs with inconsistencies in configuration parameters, e.g. when the line is initialized in an xDSL Transmission system where an xTU does not support the configured Maximum Delay or the configured Minimum or Maximum Data Rate for one or more bearer channels. 2: Configuration not feasible on the line. This error occurs if the Minimum Data Rate cann...

parameters.name: UPBOKLER
parameters.desc: This parameter contains the estimated electrical loop length estimated by the VTU-R expressed in 0.1 dB at 1MHz (see O-UPDATE in section 12.2.4.2.1.2/G.993.2). The value is coded as an unsignedInt in the range 0 (coded as 0) to 128 dB (coded as 1280) in steps of 0.1 dB . Note: This parameter is defined as UPBOKLE-R in Clause 7.5.1.23.2 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: UPBOKLEPb
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (0 to 1280, or 2047). VTU-O estimated upstream power back-off electrical length per band. This parameter is a vector of UPBO electrical length per-band estimates for each supported downstream band, expressed in 0.1 dB at 1 MHz (kl0) calculated by the VTU-R, based on separate measurements in the supported upstream bands. The value of each list element ranges from 0 to 128 dB in steps of 0.1 dB , with special value 204.7 which indicates that the estimat...

parameters.name: UPBOKLERPb
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (0 to 1280, or 2047). VTU-R estimated upstream power back-off electrical length per band. This parameter is a vector of UPBO electrical length per-band estimates for each supported downstream band, expressed in 0.1 dB at 1 MHz (kl0) calculated by the VTU-R, based on separate measurements in the supported downstream bands. The value of each list element ranges from 0 to 128 dB in steps of 0.1 dB , with special value 204.7 which indicates that the estim...

parameters.name: RXTHRSHds
parameters.desc: UPBO downstream receiver signal level threshold. This parameter reports the downstream received signal level threshold value used in the alternative electrical length estimation method (ELE-M1). This parameter represents an offset from -100 dBm/Hz, and ranges from -64 dB to 0 dB in steps of 0.1 dB . The value is coded as a 16 bit number in the range -64 (coded as -640) to 0 dB (coded as 0) in steps of 0.1 dB . Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: ACTRAMODEds
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the actual active rate adaptation mode in the downstream direction. If ACTRAMODEds equals 1, the link is operating in RA-MODE 1 (MANUAL). If ACTRAMODEds equals 2, the link is operating in RA-MODE 2 (AT_INIT). If ACTRAMODEds equals 3, the link is operating in RA-MODE 3 (DYNAMIC). If ACTRAMODEds equals 4, the link is operating in RA-MODE 4 (DYNAMIC with SOS). Note: This parameter is defined as ACT-RA-MODEds in Clause 7.5.1.33.1 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: ACTRAMODEus
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the actual active rate adaptation mode in the upstream direction. If ACTRAMODEus equals 1, the link is operating in RA-MODE 1 (MANUAL). If ACTRAMODEus equals 2, the link is operating in RA-MODE 2 (AT_INIT). If ACTRAMODEus equals 3, the link is operating in RA-MODE 3 (DYNAMIC). If ACTRAMODEus equals 4, the link is operating in RA-MODE 4 (DYNAMIC with SOS). Note: This parameter is defined as ACT-RA-MODEus in Clause 7.5.1.33.2 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: ACTINPROCds
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the actual impulse noise protection (INP) of the robust overhead channel (ROC) in the downstream direction. The format and usage is identical to the channel status parameter Channel.{i}.ACTINP . Note: This parameter is defined as ACTINP-ROC-ds in Clause 7.5.1.34.1 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: ACTINPROCus
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the actual impulse noise protection (INP) of the robust overhead channel (ROC) in the upstream direction. The format and usage is identical to the channel status parameter Channel.{i}.ACTINP . Note: This parameter is defined as ACTINP-ROC-us in Clause 7.5.1.34.2 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: SNRMROCds
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the actual signal-to-noise margin of the robust overhead channel (ROC) in the downstream direction (expressed in 0.1 dB ). The format is identical to the format of the line status parameter SNRM margin DownstreamNoiseMargin . Note: This parameter is defined as SNRM-ROC-ds in Clause 7.5.1.35.1 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: SNRMROCus
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the actual signal-to-noise margin of the robust overhead channel (ROC) in the upstream direction (expressed in 0.1 dB ). The format is identical to the format of the line status parameter SNRM margin ( UpstreamNoiseMargin ). Note: This parameter is defined as SNRM-ROC-us in Clause 7.5.1.35.2 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: LastStateTransmittedDownstream
parameters.desc: This parameter represents the last successful transmitted initialization state in the downstream direction in the last full initialization performed on the line. Initialization states are defined in the individual xDSL Recommendations and are counted from 0 (if G.994.1 is used) or 1 (if G.994.1 is not used) up to Showtime. This parameter needs to be interpreted along with the xDSL Transmission System. This parameter is available only when, after a failed full initialization, the line diagnost...

parameters.name: LastStateTransmittedUpstream
parameters.desc: This parameter represents the last successful transmitted initialization state in the upstream direction in the last full initialization performed on the line. Initialization states are defined in the individual xDSL Recommendations and are counted from 0 (if G.994.1 is used) or 1 (if G.994.1 is not used) up to Showtime. This parameter needs to be interpreted along with the xDSL Transmission System. This parameter is available only when, after a failed full initialization, the line diagnostic...

parameters.name: UPBOKLE
parameters.desc: This parameter contains the estimated electrical loop length expressed in 0.1dB at 1MHz (see O-UPDATE in section 12.2.4.2.1.2/G.993.2). The value SHALL be coded as an unsigned 16 bit number in the range 0 (coded as 0) to 128 dB (coded as 1280) in steps of 0.1 dB. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: MREFPSDds
parameters.desc: This parameter SHALL contain the set of breakpoints exchanged in the MREFPSDds fields of the O-PRM message of G.993.2. Base64 encoded of the binary representation defined in Table 12-19/G.993.2 (maximum length is 145 octets, which requires 196 bytes for Base64 encoding). Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: MREFPSDus
parameters.desc: This parameter SHALL contain the set of breakpoints exchanged in the MREFPSDus fields of the R-PRM message of G.993.2. Base64 encoded of the binary representation defined in Table 12-19/G.993.2 (maximum length is 145 octets, which requires 196 bytes for Base64 encoding). Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: LIMITMASK
parameters.desc: Indicates the enabled VDSL2 Limit PSD mask of the selected PSD mask class. Bit mask as specified in ITU-T Recommendation G.997.1. Note: For a VDSL2-capable multimode device operating in a mode other than VDSL2, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to 0. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: US0MASK
parameters.desc: Indicates the allowed VDSL2 US0 PSD masks for Annex A operation. Bit mask as specified in see ITU-T Recommendation G.997.1. Note: For a VDSL2-capable multimode device operating in a mode other than VDSL2, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to 0. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: TRELLISds
parameters.desc: Reports whether trellis coding is enabled in the downstream direction. A value of 1 indicates that trellis coding is in use, and a value of 0 indicates that the trellis is disabled. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to -1.

parameters.name: TRELLISus
parameters.desc: Reports whether trellis coding is enabled in the upstream direction. A value of 1 indicates that trellis coding is in use, and a value of 0 indicates that the trellis is disabled. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to -1.

parameters.name: ACTSNRMODEds
parameters.desc: Reports whether the OPTIONAL virtual noise mechanism is in use in the downstream direction. A value of 1 indicates the virtual noise mechanism is not in use, and a value of 2 indicates the virtual noise mechanism is in use. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to 0.

parameters.name: ACTSNRMODEus
parameters.desc: Reports whether the OPTIONAL virtual noise mechanism is in use in the upstream direction. A value of 1 indicates the virtual noise mechanism is not in use, and a value of 2 indicates the virtual noise mechanism is in use. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to 0.

parameters.name: VirtualNoisePSDds
parameters.desc: Reports the virtual noise PSD for the downstream direction. Base64 encoded of the binary representation defined in G.997.1 by the parameter called TXREFVNds (maximum length is 97 octets, which requires 132 bytes for Base64 encoding). See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to an empty string.

parameters.name: VirtualNoisePSDus
parameters.desc: Reports the virtual noise PSD for the upstream direction. Base64 encoded of the binary representation defined in G.997.1 by the parameter called TXREFVNus (maximum length is 49 octets, which requires 68 bytes for Base64 encoding). See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to an empty string.

parameters.name: ACTUALCE
parameters.desc: Reports the actual cyclic extension, as the value of m, in use for the connection. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to 99.

parameters.name: LineNumber
parameters.desc: Signifies the line pair that the modem is using to connection. LineNumber = 1 is the innermost pair.

parameters.name: UpstreamMaxBitRate
parameters.desc: The current maximum attainable data rate upstream (expressed in Kbps ). Note: This parameter is related to the G.997.1 parameter ATTNDRus, which is measured in bits/s. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: DownstreamMaxBitRate
parameters.desc: The current maximum attainable data rate downstream (expressed in Kbps ). Note: This parameter is related to the G.997.1 parameter ATTNDRds, which is measured in bits/s. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: UpstreamNoiseMargin
parameters.desc: The current signal-to-noise ratio margin (expressed in 0.1dB ) in the upstream direction. Note: In G.997.1, this parameter is called SNRMus. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DownstreamNoiseMargin
parameters.desc: The current signal-to-noise ratio margin (expressed in 0.1dB ) in the downstream direction. Note: In G.997.1, this parameter is called SNRMds. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SNRMpbus

parameters.name: SNRMpbds
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 24) of strings. Indicates the current signal-to-noise ratio margin of each band. Interpretation of the values is as defined in ITU-T Rec. G.997.1. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: INMIATOds

parameters.name: INMIATSds

parameters.name: INMCCds

parameters.name: INMINPEQMODEds

parameters.name: UpstreamAttenuation
parameters.desc: The current upstream signal loss (expressed in 0.1dB ). Doesn't apply to VDSL2 [ G.993.2 ]. Otherwise has the same value as the single element of TestParams.SATNus . Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DownstreamAttenuation

parameters.name: UpstreamPower

parameters.name: DownstreamPower

parameters.name: XTURVersion
parameters.desc: xTU-R version field as defined in [ Section 7.4.6/G.997.1 ]. It shall contain the xTU-R firmware version and the xTU-R model, encoded in this order and separated by a space character, i.e., '(xTU-R firmware version) (xTU-R model)'.

parameters.name: XTURSerial

Note: In G.997.1, this parameter is called "xTU-R G.994.1 Vendor ID". See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

Note: In [ G.997.1 ], this parameter is called "xTU-R G.994.1 Vendor ID". See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: XTURANSIRev

parameters.name: LPATH
parameters.desc: Reports the index of the latency path supporting the bearer channel. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ Section 7.5.2.7/G.997.1 ].

parameters.name: INTLVDEPTH

parameters.name: INTLVBLOCK

parameters.name: ActualInterleavingDelay

parameters.name: ACTINP
parameters.desc: Reports the actual impulse noise protection (INP) provided by the latency path indicated in LPATH . The value is the actual INP in the L0 (i.e., Showtime) state. Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to -1.

parameters.name: INPREPORT

Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.1 ]. For a multimode device operating in a mode in which this parameter does not apply, the value of this parameter SHOULD be set to false .

parameters.name: NFEC

parameters.name: RFEC

parameters.desc: Indicates whether the interface points towards the Internet ( true ) or towards End Devices ( false ). For example: For an Internet Gateway Device, Upstream will be true for all WAN interfaces and false for all LAN interfaces. parameters.name: FirmwareVersion
parameters.desc: A string identifying the version of the modem firmware currently installed for this interface. This is applicable only when the modem firmware is separable from the overall CPE software.

parameters.name: LinkStatus
parameters.desc: Status of the FAST physical link. Enumeration of: Up Initializing EstablishingLink NoSignal Disabled Error (OPTIONAL) When LinkStatus is Up , Status is expected to be Up . When LinkStatus is Initializing or EstablishingLink or NoSignal or Disabled , Status is expected to be Down . The Error value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: CurrentProfile
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the AllowedProfiles parameter, or else be an empty string. Indicates which FAST profile is currently in use on the line.

parameters.name: PowerManagementState
parameters.desc: The power management state of the line. Enumeration of: L0 L2.1 L2.2 L3 Note: See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.9701 ].

parameters.desc: The success failure cause of the initialization. An enumeration of the following integer values: 0: Successful 1: Configuration error. Configuration error. This error occurs if the line cannot reach L0 state due to a mismatch of configuration and FTU capabilities. 2: Configuration not feasible on the line. parameters.name: UPBOKLER
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the estimate of the electrical length expressed in 0.1 dB , as determined by the FTU-R (see clause 7.3.1.4.2.1/[ G.9701 ]) and conveyed in the R-MSG1 initialization message (see clause 12.3.3.2.3/[ G.9701 ]). The value is coded as an unsignedInt in the range 0 (coded as 0) to 128 dB (coded as 1280) in steps of 0.1 dB . Note: This parameter is defined as UPBOKLE-R in Clause 7.10.4.2 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: LastTransmittedDownstreamSignal
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the downstream signal count of the last transmitted initialization signal in the last full or short initialization performed on the line. The valid values are 0..21. The downstream signal count is defined in clause 12.3.1/[ G.9701 ]. Note: See clause 7.10.2.2 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: LastTransmittedUpstreamSignal
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the upstream signal count of the last transmitted initialization signal in the last full or short initialization performed on the line. The valid values are 0..21. The upstream signal count is defined in clause 12.3.1/[ G.9701 ]. Note: See clause 7.10.2.3 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: UPBOKLE
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the electrical length expressed in 0.1dB , that would have been sent from the FTU-O to the FTU-R if the electrical length was not forced by the DPU-MIB. If the electrical length is not forced by the DPU-MIB, then this object reports the final electrical length, as determined by the FTU-O (see clause 7.3.1.4.2.1/[ G.9701 ]) and conveyed in the O-UPDATE initialization message (see clause 12.3.3.2.4/[ G.9701 ]). Note: See clause 7.10.4.1 in ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: LineNumber
parameters.desc: Signifies the line pair that the modem is using to connect. LineNumber = 1 is the innermost pair.

parameters.name: UpstreamMaxBitRate
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the attainable net data rate expressed in Kbps as defined in clause 11.4.1.1.2/[ G.9701 ]. Note: This parameter is related to the G.997.2 parameter ATTNDRus. See clause 7.11.2.1 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: DownstreamMaxBitRate
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the attainable net data rate expressed in Kbps as defined in clause 11.4.1.1.2/[ G.9701 ]. Note: This parameter is related to the G.997.2 parameter ATTNDRds. See clause 7.11.2.1 ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: UpstreamNoiseMargin
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the signal-to-noise ratio margin (as defined in clause 9.8.3.2/[ G.9701 ] and 11.4.1.3/[ G.9701 ]) in the upstream direction. A special value indicates that the signal-to-noise ratio margin is out of the range to be represented. The parameter is expressed in 0.1dB . Note: In G.997.2, this parameter is called SNRMus. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DownstreamNoiseMargin
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the signal-to-noise ratio margin (as defined in clause 9.8.3.2/[ G.9701 ] and 11.4.1.3/[ G.9701 ]) in the upstream direction. A special value indicates that the signal-to-noise ratio margin is out of the range to be represented. The parameter is expressed in 0.1dB . Note: In G.997.2, this parameter is called SNRMds. See ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UpstreamAttenuation
parameters.desc: The current upstream signal loss (expressed in 0.1dB ). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DownstreamAttenuation
parameters.desc: The current downstream signal loss (expressed in 0.1dB ). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UpstreamPower
parameters.desc: The current output power at the CPE's FAST line (expressed in 0.1dBmV ). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DownstreamPower
parameters.desc: The current received power at the CPE's FAST line (expressed in 0.1dBmV ). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SNRMRMCds
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the signal-to-noise margin for the robust management channel (RMC) in the downstream direction (express in 0.1dB ). A special value (-512) indicates that the signal-to-noise ratio margin for the RMC is out of the range to be represented. This parameter is defined in clauses 7.10.12.1 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SNRMRMCus
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the signal-to-noise margin for the robust management channel (RMC) in the upstream direction (express in 0.1dB ). A special value (-512) indicates that the signal-to-noise ratio margin for the RMC is out of the range to be represented. This parameter is defined in clauses 7.10.12.2 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BITSRMCpsds
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 4610) of integers. List items report the bit allocation values on RMC sub-carriers in RMC symbols in the downstream direction. Each pair composes of a sub-carrier index from 0..4095 and an 8 bit allocation value. There are maximum 512 pairs. This parameter is defined in clause 7.10.12.3 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BITSRMCpsus
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 4610) of integers. List items report the bit allocation values on RMC sub-carriers in RMC symbols in the upstream direction. Each pair composes of a sub-carrier index from 0..4095 and an 8 bit allocation value. There are maximum 512 pairs. This parameter is defined in clause 7.10.12.4 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: FEXTCANCELds
parameters.desc: This indicates whether FEXT cancellation in the downstream direction from all the other vectored lines into the line in the vectored group is enabled (TRUE) or disabled (FALSE). This parameter is defined as FEXT_TO_CANCEL_ENABLEds in clause 7.1.7.1 of ITU Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: FEXTCANCELus
parameters.desc: This indicates whether FEXT cancellation in the upstream direction from all the other vectored lines into the line in the vectored group is enabled (TRUE) or disabled (FALSE). This parameter is defined as FEXT_TO_CANCEL_ENABLEds in clause 7.1.7.1 of ITU Recommendation [ G.997.2 ].

parameters.name: ATTETRds

parameters.name: ATTETRus
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the attainable expected throughput expressed in Kbps as defined in clause 7.11.2.2 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.997.2 ] Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MINEFTR
parameters.desc: This parameter reports the minimum error free throughput value expressed in Kbps computed from power up as defined in clause 11.4.1.1.3 of ITU-T Recommendation [ G.9701 ] Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BytesSent

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received on the interface, including framing characters. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets transmitted out of the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received on the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived

parameters.name: ErroredSecs
parameters.desc: Total number of errored seconds as defined in ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. An errored second (ES) is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more crc anomalies, or one or more los defects, or one or more lor defects, or one or more lpr primitives. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SeverelyErroredSecs
parameters.desc: Total number of severely errored seconds as defined in ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: LOSS
parameters.desc: Total number of loss of signal seconds (LOSS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. A LOSS is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more los defects. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: LORS
parameters.desc: Total number of loss of RMC seconds (LORS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. A LORS is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more lor defects. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UAS
parameters.desc: Total number of unavailable seconds (UAS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: RTXUC
parameters.desc: This parameter reports a count of uncorrected DTU anomalies (rtx_uc). This parameter is defined in clause 7.8.5 of ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: RTXTX
parameters.desc: This parameter reports a count of retransmitted DTU anomalies (rtx_tx). This parameter is defined in clause 7.8.6 of ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SuccessBSW
parameters.desc: This parameter reports a count of the successful bit swap (BSW) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_BSW in clause 7.7.20 of ITU-T Rec. [ G.997.2 ]. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: SuccessSRA

parameters.name: SNRMTus

parameters.name: ACTINP

parameters.name: RFEC

parameters.name: DownstreamCurrRate

parameters.name: OpticalSignalLevel
parameters.desc: Current measurement of total downstream optical signal level. [ Dbm1000 ] The value is measured in dBm/1000 , i.e. the value divided by 1000 is dB relative to 1 mW. For example, -12345 means -12.345 dBm, 0 means 0 dBm (1 mW) and 12345 means 12.345 dBm. Valid values are -65.536 dBm (coded as -65536), to 65.534 dBm (coded as 65534) in 0.002 dB increments. This parameter is based on Optical signal level from [ Section 9.2.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: TransmitOpticalLevel

For example, -12345 means -12.345 dBm, 0 means 0 dBm (1 mW) and 12345 means 12.345 dBm. Valid values are -65.536 dBm (coded as -65536), to 65.534 dBm (coded as 65534) in 0.002 dB increments. This parameter is based on Transmit optical level from [ Section 9.2.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: SupportedAccessTechnologies
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Access technologies supported by the interface. Each list item is an enumeration of: GPRS (GSM with GPRS) EDGE (GSM with EDGE) UMTS UMTSHSPA (UMTS with High Speed Packet Access (HSPA [ 3GPP-HSPA ])) CDMA2000OneX CDMA2000HRPD LTE NR (5G New Radio, added in 2.14)
