parameters.name: Class
parameters.desc: The Operating Class per [ Table E-4/802.11ax ] that this radio is currently operating on.

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.desc: This Channel number in the Operating Class that this Radio is currently operating on.

parameters.name: TxPower
parameters.desc: Nominal Transmit Power EIRP that this radio is currently using for the current Channel in the Opeating Class. Represented as 2's complement signed integer in units of decibels relative to 1 mW ( dBm ).

parameters.name: TransmitPowerLimit
parameters.desc: This is the upper limit on nominal transmit Equivalent Isotropically Radiated Power (EIRP) that this radio is allowed to use for the current Class . In units of decibels relative to 1 mW dBm .

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.desc: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables disallowed operating classes and channels.

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.desc: The Operating Class per [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]. Note that the operating class identifies the band and channel width. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: ChannelList
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (up to 255). The channel numbers in this Operating Class that are not allowed to be used on this radio.

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.desc: The operating class [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]. Note that the operating class identifies the band and channel width. Values represent the OpClass field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: ChannelList
parameters.desc: The channel numbers in this operating class. Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (up to 255). Values represent the Channel List field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: Preference
parameters.desc: The reported preference for this OpClass and ChannelList , as defined in [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ]. Values represent the Preference field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: ReasonCode
parameters.desc: Reason Code. Indicates the reason for the Preference , as defined in [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ]. Values represent the Reason_Code field of the Channel Preference TLV in the most recent Channel Preference Report message [ Section 17.2.13/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: PartialBSSColor
parameters.desc: The value of the Partial Basic Service Set (BSS) Color subfield of the HEOperations.BSSColorInformation field being transmitted by BSSs operating on this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: Partial BSS Color)

parameters.name: BSSColor
parameters.desc: The value of the BSS Color subfield of the HEOperations.BSSColorInformation field being transmitted by BSSs operating on this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: BSS Color)

parameters.name: HESIGASpatialReuseValue15Allowed
parameters.desc: Indicates if the Agent is allowed to set HESIGA.SpatialReuse field to value 15 (PSR_AND_NON_SRG_OBSS_PD_PROHIBITED) in HE PPDU transmissions of this radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: HESIGA_Spatial_reuse_value15_allowed) true : allowed; false : disallowed.

parameters.name: SRGInformationValid
parameters.desc: This field indicates whether the SRG Information fields (SRG OBSS PD Min Offset, SRG OBSS PD Max Offset, SRG BSS Color Bitmap and SRG Partial BSSID Bitmap) in this command are valid. (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG Information Valid) true : SRG Information fields valid; false : SRG Information fields not valid.

parameters.name: NonSRGOffsetValid
parameters.desc: This field indicates whether the Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset field in this command is valid. (EasyMesh TLV Field: Non-SRG Offset Valid) true : Non-SRG Max Offset field valid; false : Non-SRG Max Offset field not valid.

parameters.name: PSRDisallowed
parameters.desc: Indicates if the Agent is disallowed to use Parameterized Spatial Reuse (PSR)-based Spatial Reuse for transmissions by the specified radio. (EasyMesh TLV Field: PSR Disallowed) true : PSR disallowed; false : PSR allowed.

parameters.name: NonSRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameters.desc: The value of dot11NonSRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e the Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: Non-SRG OBSSPD Max Offset) This field is valid only if NonSRGOffsetValid is true .

parameters.name: SRGOBSSPDMinOffset
parameters.desc: The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMinOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Min Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Min Offset) This field is valid only if SRGInformationValid is true .

parameters.name: SRGOBSSPDMaxOffset
parameters.desc: The value of dot11SRGAPOBSSPDMaxOffset (i.e. the SRG OBSSPD Max Offset value being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG OBSSPD Max Offset) This field is valid only if SRGInformationValid is true .

parameters.name: SRGBSSColorBitmap
parameters.desc: The value of dot11SRGAPBSSColorBitmap (i.e. the SRG BSS Color Bitmap being used to control the tranmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG BSS Color Bitmap) This field is valid only if SRGInformationValid is true .

parameters.name: SRGPartialBSSIDBitmap
parameters.desc: The value of dot11SRGAPBSSIDBitmap (i.e. the SRG Partial BSSID Color Bitmap being used to control the transmissions of the specified radio). (EasyMesh TLV Field: SRG Partial BSSID Bitmap) This field is valid only if SRGInformationValid is true . Note: See rules in section 26.10.2.3 of [17] regarding the members of an SRG.

parameters.name: NeighborBSSColorInUseBitmap
parameters.desc: Bitmap of BSS colors of Overlapping BSSs (OBSSs) that the High-Efficiency (HE) AP has identified by itself or via the autonomous BSS Color collision reports received from associated non-AP HE STAs.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID). If the instance of this BSS is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}. , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.BSSID .

parameters.name: SSID
parameters.desc: The SSID in use for this BSS. If the instance of this BSS is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}. , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.SSID .

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.desc: Whether the BSSID is currently enabled (beaconing frames are being sent) or disabled. If the instance of this BSS is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}. , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.Enable .

parameters.name: BSSTemplateRef
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Templates.BSSTemplate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. BSSTemplateRef is a reference to the BSSTemplate selected for this BSS .

parameters.name: SecurityTemplateRef
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Templates.SecurityTemplate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. SecurityTemplateRef is a reference to the SecurityTemplate selected for this BSS .

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.desc: Time in seconds since the last change to the Enabled value. If the instance of this BSS is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}. , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.SSID.{i}.LastChange .

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.desc: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

parameters.name: UnicastBytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include Multi-Link Device (MLD) traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: UnicastBytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total unicast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: MulticastBytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: MulticastBytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total multicast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: BroadcastBytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes transmitted. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: BroadcastBytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Access Point (BSS) wide statistics for total broadcast bytes received. This counter does not include MLD traffic through this BSS.

parameters.name: ByteCounterUnits
parameters.desc: Byte Counter Units. 1: kibibytes (KiB) 2: mebibytes (MiB).

parameters.name: Profile1bSTAsDisallowed
parameters.desc: Profile-1 Backhaul STA association disallowed. true : Backhaul STA association disallowed; false : Backhaul STA association allowed.

parameters.name: Profile2bSTAsDisallowed
parameters.desc: Profile-2 Backhaul STA association disallowed. true : Profile 2 bSTA disallowed; false : Profile 2 bSTA allowed.

parameters.name: AssociationAllowanceStatus
parameters.desc: The status of allowance of new client device associations on this BSS. 0: No more associations allowed, 1: Associations allowed.

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersBE
parameters.desc: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BE, defined per [ Figure 9-637/802.11-2020 ] and referenced in [ Section 17.2.22/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersBK
parameters.desc: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=BK, defined per [ Figure 9-637/802.11-2020 ] and referenced in [ Section 17.2.22/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersVI
parameters.desc: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VI, defined per [ Figure 9-637/802.11-2020 ] and referenced in [ Section 17.2.22/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: EstServiceParametersVO
parameters.desc: Estimated Service Parameters information field for AC=VO, defined per [ Figure 9-637/802.11-2020 ] and referenced in [ Section 17.2.22/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: BackhaulUse
parameters.desc: Indicates that this BSS is in use as a backhaul BSS; true : backhaul BSS in use, false : backhaul BSS not in use. In [ EasyMesh ] 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameters.name: FronthaulUse
parameters.desc: Indicates that this BSS is in use as a fronthaul BSS; true : fronthaul BSS in use, false : fronthaul BSS not in use. In [ EasyMesh ] 0 is in use and 1 is not in use.

parameters.name: R1disallowed
parameters.desc: Multi-AP Profile-1 [3] (R1) disallowed status. true : disallowed, false : allowed. In [ EasyMesh ] 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameters.name: R2disallowed
parameters.desc: Multi-AP Profile-2 [3] (R2) disallowed status. true : disallowed, false : allowed. In [ EasyMesh ] 0 is allowed and 1 is disallowed.

parameters.name: MultiBSSID
parameters.desc: Multiple BSSID Set; true : configured, false : not-configured. In [ EasyMesh ], 1 is configured and 0 is not-configured.

parameters.name: TransmittedBSSID
parameters.desc: Transmitted BSSID; true : transmitted, false : non-transmitted. In [ EasyMesh ], 1 is transmitted and 0 is non-transmitted.

parameters.name: FronthaulAKMsAllowed
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for fronthaul. Each list item is an enumeration of: psk ("psk" indicates one or more of the PSK and FT-PSK AKMs defined in [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ] typically at least "00-0F-AC:2" for interoperability) dpp ("dpp" indicates one or more of the DPP and FT-DPP AKMs defined in [ Section 8.4/EasyConnect ], typically at least "50-6F-9A:2" for interoperability) sae...

parameters.name: FronthaulSuiteSelector
parameters.desc: AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ]. This parameter applies if FronthaulAKMsAllowed includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: BackhaulAKMsAllowed
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. List items indicate Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suites/security modes allowed at this BSS for backhaul. Each list item is an enumeration of: psk ("psk" indicates one or more of the PSK and FT-PSK AKMs defined in [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ] typically at least "00-0F-AC:2" for interoperability) dpp ("dpp" indicates one or more of the DPP and FT-DPP AKMs defined in [ Section 8.4/EasyConnect ], typically at least "50-6F-9A:2" for interoperability) sae ...

parameters.name: BackhaulSuiteSelector
parameters.desc: AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ]. This parameter applies if BackhaulAKMsAllowed includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: BasicDataTransmitRates
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers. The current basic data rates; the set of data rates, in kbps , that have to be supported by all stations that desire to join this BSS. The stations have to be able to receive and transmit at each of the data rates listed in BasicDataTransmitRates . Most control packets use a data rate in BasicDataTransmitRates .

parameters.name: ULRU242PPDUCount

parameters.name: BlacklistAttempts
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times a Blacklist steer was attempted for this Access Point. Blacklist steering is the process of forcing a connected STA to move to another Access Point by temporarily blocking its access to the current Access Point.

parameters.name: BTMAttempts
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times a BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ Sections 4.3.19.3 and 6.3.57/802.11-2020 ] steer was attempted for this Access Point.

parameters.name: BTMQueryResponses
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of asynchronous BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ Sections 4.3.19.3 and 6.3.57/802.11-2020 ] Queries for which a BTM Request was issued by this Access Point.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.desc: Timestamp for the throughput test, indicating when the test completed.

parameters.name: ClientMAC
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] MAC address of the STA that the throughput test ran to.

parameters.name: VID
parameters.desc: The VLAN ID (VID) that the throughput test ran on. A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameters.name: WMMUP
parameters.desc: Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) [ WMM ] that the throughput test was requested to run on. A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameters.name: TestDuration
parameters.desc: Duration of the throughput test in milliseconds .

parameters.name: TestLayer
parameters.desc: The OSI layer that the throughput test ran on.

parameters.name: TestAlgorithm
parameters.desc: The test algorithm that the throughput test used.

parameters.name: DownlinkSpeed
parameters.desc: Downlink speed found by the throughput test in kbps .

parameters.name: UplinkSpeed
parameters.desc: Uplink speed found by the throughput test in kbps .

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.desc: Timestamp for the latency test, indicating when the last echo in the latency test set was received or timed-out.

parameters.name: ClientMAC
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] MAC address of the station (STA) or EasyMesh Agent that the latency test ran to.

parameters.name: VID
parameters.desc: The VLAN ID (VID) that the latency test ran on. A value of 0 indicates that no VLAN was specified.

parameters.name: WMMUP
parameters.desc: Wireless MultiMedia (WMM) User Priority (UP) [ WMM ] that the latency test was requested to run on. A value of 8 indicates that no UP was specified.

parameters.name: DataBlockSize
parameters.desc: The size of each data block, in bytes , that was transmitted in each echo test. The data block excludes the packet or frame header. A value of 0 indicates that no DataBlockSize was specified.

parameters.name: TestLayer
parameters.desc: The OSI layer that the latency test ran on.

parameters.name: TestAlgorithm
parameters.desc: The test algorithm that the latency test used.

parameters.name: SuccessCount
parameters.desc: The number of successfully received echo responses. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: LostCount
parameters.desc: The number of lost echoes in the latency test set. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: AverageResponseTime
parameters.desc: The average round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in milliseconds . This average is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: MinimumResponseTime
parameters.desc: The minimum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in milliseconds . This minimum is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: MaximumResponseTime
parameters.desc: The maximum round-trip time of the results of the latency test set in milliseconds . This maximum is across successfully received echoes only. This parameter is an output of the latency test.

parameters.name: QosMapEnable
parameters.desc: Indicates whether QoS Map is enabled on this BSS.

parameters.name: MSCSEnable
parameters.desc: Indicates whether Mirrored Stream Classification Service (MSCS) is enabled on this BSS.

parameters.name: SCSEnable
parameters.desc: Indicates whether Stream Classification Service (SCS) is enabled on this BSS.

parameters.name: DSCPPolicyEnable
parameters.desc: Indicates whether DSCP Policy is enabled on this BSS.

parameters.name: SCSTrafficDescriptionEnable
parameters.desc: Indicates whether the extensions to SCS using Traffic Descriptions is enabled on this BSS.

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The MAC address of an associated device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.MACAddress .

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.desc: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

parameters.name: HTCapabilities
parameters.desc: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). Uses the format defined by the AP HTCapabilities TLV [ Section 17.2.8/EasyMesh ]. Includes all fields in the AP HTCapabilities TLV except tlvType, tlvLength, tlvValue and RUID.

parameters.name: VHTCapabilities
parameters.desc: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). Uses the format defined by the AP VHTCapabilities TLV [ Section 17.2.9/EasyMesh ]. Includes all fields in the AP VHTCapabilities TLV except tlvType, tlvLength, tlvValue and RUID.

parameters.name: ClientCapabilities
parameters.desc: The frame body of the most recently received (Re)Association Request frame from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of [ 802.11-2020 ] in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

parameters.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameters.desc: The data transmit rate in kbps that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the associated device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataDownlinkRate .

parameters.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameters.desc: The data transmit rate in kbps that was most recently used for transmission of data from the associated device to the access point. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataUplinkRate .

parameters.name: UtilizationReceive
parameters.desc: The amount of time in milliseconds that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from this Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameters.desc: The amount of time in milliseconds that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to this Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameters.desc: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in Mbps achievable in the downlink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameters.desc: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in Mbps achievable in the uplink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ].

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.desc: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the associated STA to the access point - measured in dBm . RCPI is encoded per [ Table 9-176/802.11-2020 ], and described in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ]). Reserved: 221 - 255. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.SignalStrength .

parameters.name: LastConnectTime
parameters.desc: The time in seconds since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesSent .

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesReceived .

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsSent .

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received from the Associated Device. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsReceived .

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit, or from other causes. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsSent .

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of inbound packets that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsReceived .

parameters.name: RetransCount
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of transmitted packets which were retransmissions. Two retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by two. If the instance of this STA is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i} , then this parameter is the same as Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.RetransCount .

parameters.name: MeasurementReport
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of Base64s. Measurement Report element(s) received from the Associated Device (STA) that constitute the latest Beacon report as defined in [ Figure 9-230/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: NumberOfMeasureReports
parameters.desc: The number of measurement report elements contained in MeasurementReport .

parameters.name: IPV4Address
parameters.desc: [ IPv4Address ] IPV4 Address assigned to the client.

parameters.name: IPV6Address
parameters.desc: [ IPv6Address ] IPV6Address assigned to the client.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.desc: Hostname assigned to the client.

parameters.name: CellularDataPreference
parameters.desc: This is the Cellular Data Preference for a Agile Multiband (AMB) capable STA This specifies the use of the cellular data connection. [ AMB ] Enumeration of: Excluded Should not use Should use

parameters.name: ReAssociationDelay
parameters.desc: Re-association Delay [ AMB ]. The time, in seconds , after a BTM steer from AP1 to AP2 during which the station cannot go back and re-associate with AP1.

parameters.name: SleepMode
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the current operating sleep mode as recorded by the BSS [ 802.11-2020 ]. Enumeration of: Not_Asleep WNM_Sleep_Mode TPU_Sleep TDLS_Peer_Power_Save_Mode_(PSM) AP_PS-Poll TWT_Sleep Light_Sleep Deep_Sleep

parameters.name: SecurityAssociation
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the current operating security state as defined in [ Section 12.6.1.1/802.11-2020 ]. Enumeration of: PMKSA PMK-R0 PMK-R1 Mesh_PMKSA Mesh_TKSA PTKSA GTKSA IGTKSA Mesh_GTKSA BIGTKSA TPKSA Other

parameters.name: PairwiseAKM
parameters.desc: Pairwise AKM suite selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: PairwiseCipher
parameters.desc: Pairwise AKM cipher selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM cipher selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-149, OUI field/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: RSNCapabilities
parameters.desc: The RSN Capabilities selected by the STA during association [ Section 9.4.2.24.4,/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TIDQueueSizesNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the TIDQueueSizes table.

parameters.name: SteeringHistoryNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the SteeringHistory table.

parameters.name: NoCandidateAPFailures
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times this Associated Device should have been steered but wasn't because a better candidate AP couldn't be found.

parameters.name: BlacklistAttempts
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times a Blacklist steer was attempted on this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BlacklistSuccesses
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times an attempted Blacklist steer succeeded for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BlacklistFailures
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times an attempted Blacklist steer failed for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMAttempts
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times a BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ 802.11k ]) steer was attempted on this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMSuccesses
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times an attempted BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ 802.11k ]) steer succeeded for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMFailures
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of times an attempted BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ 802.11k ]) steer failed for this Associated Device.

parameters.name: BTMQueryResponses
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of asynchronous BTM (BSS Transition Management; [ 802.11k ]) Queries for which a BTM Request was issued to this Associated Device.

parameters.name: LastSteerTime
parameters.desc: The number of seconds since this Associated Device was last attempted to be steered.

parameters.name: Time
parameters.desc: The date/time when steering was initiated for the Associated Device.

parameters.name: APOrigin
parameters.desc: The BSSID of the Access Point that initiated the steering.

parameters.name: TriggerEvent
parameters.desc: The type of event that caused the steering to be initiaited. Enumeration of: Unknown Wi-Fi Channel Utilization Wi-Fi Link Quality Backhaul Link Utilization NOTE: This might be Unknown for BTM Query Response steers.

parameters.name: SteeringApproach
parameters.desc: The type of steering that was attempted. Enumeration of: Blacklist BTM Request Async BTM Query

parameters.name: APDestination
parameters.desc: The BSSID of the destination Access Point of a successful steer. A failed steering attempt will leave this parameter an empty string.

parameters.name: SteeringDuration
parameters.desc: The amount of time in seconds required for the steer to complete successfully. A failed steering attempt will leave this parameter 0.

HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 160MHz is present if 160MHz is supported. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 80+80MHz is present if 80+80MHz is supported.

parameters.name: BeamformeeAbove80

parameters.name: ULMUMIMO

parameters.name: ULOFDMA

parameters.name: SpatialReuse

parameters.name: AnticipatedChannelUsage

parameters.name: BW4MHz

parameters.name: BW8MHz

parameters.name: BW1MHzShortGI
parameters.desc: Indicates support for 1 MHz short Guard Interval (GI).

parameters.name: BW2MHzShortGI
parameters.desc: Indicates support for 2 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW4MHzShortGI
parameters.desc: Indicates support for 4 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW8MHzShortGI
parameters.desc: Indicates support for 8 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: BW16MHzShortGI
parameters.desc: Indicates support for 16 MHz short GI.

parameters.name: AMSDU
parameters.desc: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Service Data Units (AMSDU).

parameters.name: AMPDU
parameters.desc: Indicates support of Aggregated MAC Protocol Data Units (AMPDU).

parameters.name: FlowControl
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Flow Control [ Section 10.61/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: CentralizedAuthenticationControl
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Centralized Authentication Control [ Section 11.3.9.2/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: DistributedAuthenticationControl
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Distributed Authentication Control (DAC) [ Section 11.3.9.3/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: MaxMPDULen
parameters.desc: Indicates the maximum MAC Protocol Data Unit (MPDU) length in octets. Enumeration of: 3895 7991

parameters.name: NonTIMMode

parameters.name: DynamicAID
parameters.desc: Indicates support of Dynamic Association ID (AID) operation [ Section 10.20/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: GroupAID
parameters.desc: Indicates support of Group Association ID (AID) [ Section 10.55/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: BATSupport

parameters.name: RAWOperation
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Restricted access window (RAW) operation [ Section 10.23.5/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: PageSlicing
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Page Slicing Operation [ Section 10.51/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: PV1Frame
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Protocol Version 1 (PV1) frames [ Section 9.8/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TxMCSNSS
parameters.desc: Supported Tx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in [ Figure 9-694/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: RxMCSNSS
parameters.desc: Supported Rx S1G-MCS Map subfield and Coding Scheme (S1G-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in [ Figure 9-694/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: SUBeamformer

parameters.name: SUBeamformee

parameters.name: MUBeamformer
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer [ Section 10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: MUBeamformee
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformee [ Section 10.36.5 VHT sounding protocol/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TravelingPilot
parameters.desc: Indicates support for or the reception of PPDUs with traveling pilots [ Section 10.56 Traveling pilot operation/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TWTGrouping
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Grouping [ Section 10.47.5 TWT grouping/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TWTRequestor
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Requestor [ Section 10.47 Target wake time (TWT)/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: TWTResponder
parameters.desc: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) TWTResponder [ Section 10.47 Target wake time (TWT)/802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: IsSensorDevice
parameters.desc: Indicates if this is a sensor device. A value of false indicates this is a non-sensor device.

parameters.name: TID
parameters.desc: The TID of the corresponding Queue Size field.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.desc: Queue Size for this TID. Its format is defined in Table 9-10-QoS Control field [ 802.11-2020 ].

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The MAC address of the Non-AP STA.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.desc: An indicator of radio signal strength (RCPI) of the uplink from the Non-AP STA - measured in dBm . RCPI is encoded per [ Table 9-176/802.11-2020 ], and described in [ Section 10.3.2/EasyMesh ]. Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameters.name: OperatingClass
parameters.desc: Operating class on which this unassociated STA was last detected, per [ Table E-4/802.11ax ].

parameters.name: Channel
parameters.desc: Channel on which this unassociated STA was last detected.

parameters.desc: Enables or disables WPS functionality for this EasyMesh agent or single AP.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: Indicates the current status of WPS. If the device goes to SetupLocked the WPS needs to be disabled and re-enabled to come out of this state. Enumeration of: Disabled Error Unconfigured Configured SetupLocked InProgress

parameters.name: MLDMACAddress
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The Multi-Link Device (MLD) MAC Address of the MLO Capable access point (AP). [ EasyMesh ] Source: Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV.

parameters.name: APMLDTemplateRef
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Templates.APMLDTemplate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. APMLDTemplateRef is a reference to the APMLDTemplate selected for this APMLD .

parameters.name: TIDLinkMapNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the TIDLinkMap table.

parameters.name: AffiliatedAPNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the AffiliatedAP table.

parameters.name: STAMLDNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the STAMLD table.

parameters.name: LinkToOpClassMapNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the LinkToOpClassMap table.

parameters.name: EMLMREnabled
parameters.desc: Indicates if the Enhanced Multi-Link Multi-Radio (EMLMR) operation is enabled.

parameters.name: EMLSREnabled

parameters.name: NSTREnabled

parameters.name: TIDLinkMapNegotiation

parameters.name: TIDToOpClassPolicyNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the TIDToOpClassPolicy table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates whether the TID-to-Link mapping entry is enabled for Multi-Link Operation (MLO) on the access point (AP). When set to "true", the mapping between the specified Traffic Identifier (TID), direction, and required Operating Class will be active, and the TID-to-Link mapping policy will be applied during Multi-Link operations. When set to "false", the entry will be ignored.

parameters.name: TID
parameters.desc: The traffic identifier (TID) for this mapping. This TID is a unique key for this table. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with Direction ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (up to 255). The Operating class of an available channel, from [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]. The TID can be mapped to any link using a radio with a current operating class within this list.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.desc: The direction of the traffic flow from the perspective the AP MLD. Enumeration of: Up Down This Direction is a unique key for this table. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with TID ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.desc: The direction of the traffic flow from the perspective of the AP MLD. Enumeration of: Up Down

parameters.name: TID
parameters.desc: The traffic identifier (TID) for this mapping.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The BSSID of the preferred link (affiliated AP) to use for traffic with matching direction and TID values.

parameters.name: LinkID
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (0 to 15). The Link ID of the preferred link (affiliated AP) to use for traffic with matching direction and TID values.

parameters.name: LinkID
parameters.desc: The Link ID assigned to one of the affiliated APs of this AP MLD. [ Section 17.2.96, Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV/EasyMesh ]

parameters.name: OpClass
parameters.desc: One of the current Operating Class per [ Table E-4/802.11ax ] that the Radio on which the Affiliated AP with the given LinkID is operating on.

parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.desc: [ MACAddress ] The BSSID of the affiliated AP. This should be set to one of the values of Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.BSSID . [ EasyMesh ] source: Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV.

parameters.name: LinkID
parameters.desc: The Link ID assigned to this affiliated AP. [ EasyMesh ] source: Agent AP MLD Configuration TLV.

If an EasyMesh Agent does not match any value in the list, then no BSS is deployed on this EasyMesh Agent. parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the SSCTemplate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. parameters.desc: Determines if this RadioTemplate is considered by the Configuration Template Manager (CTM) in the template matching process. This value is independent from the value of any Radio.{i}.Enable . This value is also independent from the value of any DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.Enabled .

parameters.name: OpClassFlag
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (up to 255). Each list item is a global valid operating class as defined in [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]). Indicates the Operating Classes the Radio can operate on. Exactly one of OpClassFlag or BandFlag must be empty and exactly one must be filled in. A Radio must be able to operate on at least one channel of each Operating Class specified in this list to satisfy this condition.

parameters.name: BandFlag
parameters.desc: Indicates frequency bands the Radio can operate on. All listed UNII bands are to be in the same 2.4, 5 or 6 GHz band. Exactly one of OpClassFlag or BandFlag must be empty. Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item is an enumeration of: 2.4 (2.4 GHz band) 5 (The entire 5 GHz band) 6 (The entire 6 GHz band) 5_UNII_1 (5 GHz UNII-1 band, 5.15 to 5.25 GHz) 5_UNII_2 (5 GHz UNII-2 band, 5.25 to 5.725 GHz) 5_UNII_3 (5 GHz UNII-3 band, 5.725 to 5.85 GHz) 5_UNII_4 (5 GHz UNII-4 band, 5.85 to 5.92...

If an EasyMesh agent or device supports a Wi-Fi Generation not in the list, then that Wi-Fi Generation is disabled on the EasyMesh agent or device. Enumeration of: true (The AP shall indicate support for RSNO for this flag to match) false (The AP shall not indicate support for RSNO for this flag to match) null (This flag matches in all cases)

parameters.name: SupportedAKMSuiteFlag
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suite selector. Only the listed enumeration values are allowed in this string. Each list item is an enumeration of: psk (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:2) dpp (indicates AKM 50-6F-9A:2) sae (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:8) sae-ext-key (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:24) SuiteSelector (indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in SupportedAKMSuiteSelectorFlag )

parameters.name: SupportedAKMSuiteSelectorFlag
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of Hex binarys (length 4). AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ]. SupportedAKMSuiteSelectorFlag applies if SupportedAKMSuiteFlag includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: OperatingGenerationFlag
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (1 to 255). The AP advertises support in its beacon frames for each Wi-Fi generation in this list for this flag to match. For example OperatingGenerationFlag could be "5,6,7".

parameters.name: SecurityIEs
parameters.desc: Concatenation of all BSS Security related IEs with Element IDs, without delimiters as hex encoded octets [ EasyMesh ]. Note that this SecurityIEs and the RSNE , RSNOE , RSNO2E , RSNXE , RSNXOE objects are independent and may be set separately. If this SecurityIEs is not empty, the Configuration Template Manager (CTM) uses the value of this SecurityIEs and ignores the content of the RSNE/RSNOE/RSNO2E/RSNXE/RSNXOE objects.

parameters.name: GroupDataCipherSuite
parameters.desc: Cipher suite selector used to protect group addressed data frames. This is the name of a cipher suite, as defined in [ Table 9-149/802.11-2020 ]. The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameters.name: PairwiseCipherSuite
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item is a cipher suite selector used to protect individually addressed Data frames, as defined in [ Table 9-149/802.11-2020 ]. The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameters.name: AKMSuite
parameters.desc: Authentication and Key Management (AKM) suite [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ]. Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item is an enumeration of: psk (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:2) dpp (indicates AKM 50-6F-9A:2) sae (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:8) sae-ext-key (indicates AKM 00-0F-AC:24) SuiteSelector (indicates an AKM suite selector, the value of which is indicated in AKMSuiteSelector )

parameters.name: AKMSuiteSelector
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of Hex binarys (length 4). AKM suite selector, the AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 [ Table 9-151/802.11-2020 ]. AKMSuiteSelector applies if AKMSuite includes value "SuiteSelector".

parameters.name: MFP

parameters.name: GroupManagementCipherSuite

parameters.name: GroupDataCipherSuite
parameters.desc: Cipher suite selector used to protect group addressed data frames. This is the name of a cipher suite, as defined in [ Table 9-149/802.11-2020 ]. The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameters.name: PairwiseCipherSuite
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item is a cipher suite selector used to protect individually addressed Data frames, as defined in [ Table 9-149/802.11-2020 ]. The following is an example value: "CCMP-128".

parameters.name: AKMSuite
