parameters.name: RetryEnable
parameters.desc: When true , the CPE retries unsuccessful attempts to transfer data.

parameters.name: RetryMinimumWaitInterval
parameters.desc: Configures the data transfer retry wait interval, in seconds, as specified in [ Annex A.1.2.1/TR-369 ]. The device MUST use a random value between RetryMinimumWaitInterval and ( RetryMinimumWaitInterval * RetryIntervalMultiplier / 1000) as the first retry wait interval. Other values in the retry pattern MUST be calculated using this value as a starting point.

parameters.name: RetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.desc: Configures the retry interval multiplier as specified in [ Annex A.1.2.1/TR-369 ]. This value is expressed in units of 0.001. Hence the values of the multiplier range between 1.000 and 65.535. The device MUST use a random value between RetryMinimumWaitInterval and ( RetryMinimumWaitInterval * RetryIntervalMultiplier / 1000) as the first retry wait interval. Other values in the retry pattern MUST be calculated using this value as a starting point.

parameters.desc: The Agent MUST use this QoS value when sending the Bulk Data report. If the referenced MQTT Client uses MQTT 5.0 and the MQTT server only indicates support for a QoS value in the CONNACK Maximum QoS property lower than this QoS value, the Agent MUST use the highest QoS value that is supported by the server.

parameters.desc: If set to true the Agent MUST set the RETAIN flag in MQTT PUBLISH messages carrying the Bulk Data report to 1, unless the MQTT server sent Retain Available = 0 (MQTT 5.0) in its CONNACK (in which case, the Agent MUST set the RETAIN flag to 0).

parameters.name: ExecEnvLabel
parameters.desc: The name of this ExecutionUnit as provided by the ExecEnv , which SHOULD be unique across all ExecutionUnit instances contained within a specific ExecEnv .

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: Indicates the status of this ExecutionUnit . Enumeration of: Idle (This instance is in an Idle state and not running) Starting (This instance is in the process of Starting and SHOULD transition to the Active state) Active (This instance is currently running) Stopping (This instance is in the process of Stopping and SHOULD transition to the Idle state) Restarting (This instance is in the process of Restarting and SHOULD transition to the Active state, added in 2.16)

parameters.name: ExecutionFaultCode
parameters.desc: If while running or transitioning between states this ExecutionUnit identifies a fault this parameter embodies the problem. The value of NoFault MUST be used when everything is working as intended. Enumeration of: NoFault FailureOnStart FailureOnAutoStart FailureOnStop FailureWhileActive DependencyFailure UnStartable For fault codes not included in this list, the vendor MAY include vendor-specific values, which MUST use the format defined in [ Section 3.3/TR-106 ].

parameters.name: ExecutionFaultMessage
parameters.desc: If while running or transitioning between states this ExecutionUnit identifies a fault this parameter provides a more detailed explanation of the problem. If ExecutionFaultCode has the value of NoFault then the value of this parameter MUST be an empty string and ignored by the Controller.

parameters.name: AutoStart
parameters.desc: If true and the RunLevel verification is also met, then this ExecutionUnit will be automatically started by the device after its ExecEnv is either rebooted or restarted. If false this ExecutionUnit will not be started after its ExecEnv is either rebooted or restarted until it is explicitly commanded to do so by either the Controller or another Execution Unit.

parameters.name: RunLevel
parameters.desc: Determines when this ExecutionUnit will be started. If AutoStart is true and ExecEnv.{i}.CurrentRunLevel is greater than or equal to RunLevel , then this ExecutionUnit will be started. If the value of ExecEnv.{i}.CurrentRunLevel is -1, then the associated ExecEnv. doesn't support Run Levels, thus the value of this parameter is irrelevant when read and setting its value has no impact to the Run Level of this ExecutionUnit .

parameters.name: Vendor
parameters.desc: Vendor of this ExecutionUnit .

parameters.desc: Version of the ExecutionUnit . The format of this value is Execution Environment specific.

parameters.name: Privileged
parameters.desc: The Privileged mode for this ExecutionUnit : true for Privileged, false for Unprivileged.

parameters.name: AllocatedDiskSpace
parameters.desc: The amount of persistent physical storage measured in KiB allocated to this Execution Environment. This constraint applies to persistent physical storage used by the Execution Environment and its child Deployment Units and Execution Units. The accounting of in-memory application data volumes is excluded. A value of -1 indicates that this parameter is not applicable (i.e., no persistent physical storage constraint is enforced for this ExecutionUnit ).

parameters.name: DiskSpaceInUse
parameters.desc: The amount of persistent physical storage measured in KiB currently being used by this ExecutionUnit . A value of -1 MUST be used for ExecutionUnit instances where this parameter is not applicable. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: AllocatedMemory
parameters.desc: The amount of physical RAM measured in KiB allocated to this ExecutionUnit . A value of -1 MUST be used for ExecutionUnit instances where this parameter is not applicable.

parameters.name: MemoryInUse
parameters.desc: The amount of physical RAM measured in KiB currently being used by this ExecutionUnit . A value of -1 MUST be used for ExecutionUnit instances where this parameter is not applicable. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: AllocatedCPUPercent
parameters.desc: The CPU power allocated to this ExecutionUnit , as a fraction (in % ) of the CPU allocation of the ExecEnv in which this ExecutionUnit resides. A value of -1 MUST be used for ExecutionUnit instances where this parameter is not applicable.

parameters.name: CPUPercentInUse
parameters.desc: The CPU power currently being used by this ExecutionUnit , as a fraction (in % ) of the CPU allocation of the ExecEnv in which this ExecutionUnit resides. A value of -1 MUST be used for ExecutionUnit instances where this parameter is not applicable.

parameters.name: AllocatedEUUID
parameters.desc: This parameter is allocated by the host system. This is the user identifier within the execution unit's environment. This UID is local to the execution unit and is used by the Execution Unit's internal processes to manage permissions. By default, processes within the Execution Unit execute as root (UID 0) unless otherwise specified.

parameters.name: AllocatedEUGID
parameters.desc: This parameter is allocated by the host system. This is the group identifier within the execution unit's environment. This GID is local to the execution unit and is used by the Execution Unit's internal processes to manage permissions.

parameters.name: AllocatedHostUID
parameters.desc: This parameter is allocated by the host system. This is the user identifier on the host system where this Execution Unit is running. This UID is system wide and is managed by the kernel.

parameters.name: AllocatedHostGID
parameters.desc: This parameter is allocated by the host system. This is the group identifier on the host system where this Execution Unit is running. This GID is system wide and is managed by the kernel.

parameters.name: CreationTime
parameters.desc: The date and time when the Execution Unit was created.

parameters.name: Uptime
parameters.desc: The amount of time in seconds that this Execution Unit has been up and running since it was activated.

parameters.name: ShutdownDelay
parameters.desc: The delay in seconds before which the container is shutdown. This delay ensures that the application has enough time to perform any cleanup before the Execution Unit transitions to idle state. The default value SHOULD be 10 .

parameters.name: References
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item MUST be the Path Name of a table row, or an empty string. Represents the instances of multi-instanced objects that are directly controlled by, and have come into existence because of, this ExecutionUnit . NOTE: All other objects and parameters (i.e. not multi-instanced objects) that this ExecutionUnit has caused to come into existence can be discovered via the GetSupportedDM and GetInstances USP messages.

If Status is not Active it is expected that this list will be an empty string. Some ExecutionUnit instances MIGHT NOT have any system processes irrespective of the value of Status .

If the referenced object is deleted, the corresponding item MUST be removed from the list. parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item MUST be a member of the list reported by the Users.SupportedCapabilities parameter. This is the list of User Role instances that in turn yields a set of capabilities available to this ExecutionUnit . parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings (maximum number of characters per item 256). Each item in the list can be an Object Path, Command Path, Event Path, or Parameter Path that determines the element(s) of the data model that the application has permission to register. If this parameter is an empty string then the application has no permission to register any data model paths.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enable the auto-restart feature for this Execution Unit. The default value SHOULD be false .

parameters.name: RetryMinimumWaitInterval
parameters.desc: Configures the initial delay in seconds between detecting that the Execution Unit has terminated abnormally and re-starting it.

parameters.name: RetryMaximumWaitInterval
parameters.desc: Configures the maximum delay in seconds between detecting that the Execution Unit has terminated abnormally and re-starting it.

parameters.name: RetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.desc: Configures the retry interval multiplier. This value is expressed in units of 0.001, so for example a value of 2000 will result in the retry interval being doubled each time.

parameters.name: MaximumRetryCount
parameters.desc: Configures the maximum number of consecutive restarts (as shown in RetryCount ) after which no more attempts will be performed. A value of zero means that the number of attempts is unlimited.

parameters.name: ResetPeriod
parameters.desc: If the Execution Unit runs for this number of seconds without terminating abnormally the Agent MAY reset the RetryCount to zero, thereby resetting the exponential backoff algorithm. A value of zero disables this behavior.

parameters.name: RetryCount
parameters.desc: The number times the Execution Unit has terminated abnormally and a restart has been attempted. Resetting this parameter to zero has the effect of re-initialising the exponential back-off algorithm. Invoking the Restart() command also has the effect of resetting this parameter to zero.

parameters.name: LastRestarted
parameters.desc: The time at which the ExecutionUnit was last re-started. Initially this parameter is set to the Unknown Time (0001-01-01T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: NextRestart
parameters.desc: The time at which the next restart of the ExecutionUnit is scheduled to occur. The Infinite Time (9999-12-31T23:59:59Z) is used to indicate that no restart is currently scheduled.

The value is set to an empty string if the Action is Invalid and the system is unable to retrieve the CurrentModuleVersion value from the configuration. parameters.name: RequestResponseInfo
parameters.desc: The MQTT client uses this value in a MQTT CONNECT packet to request the Server to return Response Information in the MQTT CONNACK (see [ Section 3.1.2.11.6/MQTT50 ]). A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: RequestProblemInfo
parameters.desc: This value indicates whether the Reason String or User Properties are sent in the case of failures.(see [ Section 3.1.2.11.7/MQTT50 ]). A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: AuthenticationMethod
parameters.desc: This value defines the extended authentication method to be used (see [ Section 3.1.2.11.9/MQTT50 ]). If the parameter is empty, no extended authentication is performed. A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: ALPN
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings (length 0 to 256). The supported protocol(s) to be advertised in a TLS handshake using the Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation (ALPN) extension as defined in [ RFC7301 ]. If the parameter is empty, that is an indication that ALPN is not being used. A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed.

parameters.name: ClientID
parameters.desc: The MQTT client identifier used in the MQTT CONNECT packet (see [ Section 3.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 3.1.3.1/MQTT311 ]) or [ Section 3.1.3.1/MQTT50 ]). If ProtocolVersion is set to 3.1 or 3.1.1 , this parameter MUST NOT be an empty string. If ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 , an empty string is allowed. A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed.

parameters.name: WillDelayInterval
parameters.desc: The delay in seconds after the session is disconnected, before sending the Will message [ Section 3.1.3.2.2/MQTT50 ]). A value of 0 indicates that there is no delay. A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If will handling is enabled (Parameter WillEnable is set to true ) and the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: WillMessageExpiryInterval
parameters.desc: The lifetime in seconds of a Will Message (see [ Section 3.1.3.2.4/MQTT50 ]). A value of 0 indicates that no message expiry interval value is specified for in the will message properties of a CONNECT packet. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: WillContentType
parameters.desc: Describes the type of the WillValue [ Section 3.1.3.2.5/MQTT50 ]). A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If will handling is enabled (Parameter WillEnable is set to true ) and the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: WillResponseTopic

If the WillResponseTopic is an empty string the will response topic will not be sent in a MQTT CONNECT packet. A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If will handling is enabled (Parameter WillEnable is set to true ) and the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconne...

parameters.name: WillTopic
parameters.desc: The Topic sent in the Will Message (see [ Section 3.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 3.1.3.3/MQTT311 ]) or [ Section 3.1.3.3/MQTT50 ]). This parameter is only used if WillEnable is set to true . A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If will handling is enabled (Parameter WillEnable is set to true ) and the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed.

parameters.name: WillValue
parameters.desc: The value sent in the Will Message (see [ Section 3.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 3.1.2.5/MQTT311 ]) or [ Section 3.1.3.4/MQTT50 ]). This parameter is only used if WillEnable is set to true . A change of this parameter is only communicated to the MQTT server with the next MQTT CONNECT packet. If will handling is enabled (Parameter WillEnable is set to true ) and the change needs to be applied immediately, the command ForceReconnect() has to be executed.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.desc: Username used to authenticate the MQTT client when making a connection to the MQTT broker. The value is sent in the MQTT CONNECT packet (see [ Section 3.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 3.1.3.4/MQTT311 ] or [ Section 3.1.3.5/MQTT50 ]). If this parameter is an empty string no authentication parameters are sent in the MQTT CONNECT packet.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.desc: Password used to authenticate the MQTT client when making a connection to the MQTT broker. The value is sent in the MQTT CONNECT packet (see [ Section 3.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 3.1.3.5/MQTT311 ] or [ Section 3.1.3.6/MQTT50 ]). This password is only sent in the MQTT CONNECT packet if Username is not an empty string. When read, this parameter returns an empty string, regardless of the actual value, unless the Controller has a "secured" role.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.Certificate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the client certificate that must be presented to the remote server for mutual authentication. This certificate is used to authenticate the client by the remote server, ensuring that the remote server is communicating with a trusted client. The client certificate must be issued by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA) and...

parameters.name: CABundle
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.CABundle. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the group of CA certificate(s) that the client must use to validate the certificate presented by the remote server. These CA certificates form a trust chain that the server certificate must match, ensuring that only servers with trusted certificates can establish a connection. This parameter supports multiple CA certificat...

parameters.name: CipherList
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each item in this list specifies a cipher that the TLS client is allowed to use. When an empty string the system defaults are used.

parameters.name: PublishMessageExpiryInterval
parameters.desc: The lifetime in seconds of a PUBLISH Message (see [ Section 3.3.2.3.3/MQTT50 ]). A value of 0 indicates that no message expiry interval value is included in the PUBLISH packet. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 5.0 .

parameters.name: MessageRetryTime
parameters.desc: Message retry time in seconds defines the wait time before a MQTT message that expects a response (QoS value of message is > 0, or PUBLISH, PUBREL, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE message) is resent, because the response is not received (see [ Section 4.2/MQTT311 ]). This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 3.1 .

parameters.name: ConnectRetryTime
parameters.desc: Connect retry time in seconds defines the wait time before a failed MQTT broker connection is retried. A failure can either be on the connection level (the TCP/IP or TLS can not be established) or on the Protocol level, the MQTT client does not receive a MQTT CONNACK packet on a MQTT CONNECT packet sent. parameters.name: ConnectRetryIntervalMultiplier
parameters.desc: Configures the retry interval multiplier. This value is expressed in units of 0.001. Hence the values of the multiplier range between 1.000 and 65.535.

parameters.name: ConnectRetryMaxInterval
parameters.desc: The maximum reconnection wait interval, in seconds .

parameters.name: ResponseInformation
parameters.desc: The value of the CONNACK Response Information property supplied by a MQTT 5.0 server. This value is used by a MQTT 5.0 client as the basis for the PUBLISH Response Topic property for all PUBLISH packets that expect a response. If the value of ResponseInformation is not a subset (wildcarded or precise match) of any of the Subscription.{i}.Topic values the MQTT client MUST subscribe to this Topic.

When read, this parameter returns an empty string, regardless of the actual value, unless the Controller has a "secured" role.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.Certificate. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the client certificate that must be presented to the remote server for mutual authentication. This certificate is used to authenticate the client by the remote server, ensuring that the remote server is communicating with a trusted client. The client certificate must be issued by a trusted Certificate Authority (CA) and...

parameters.name: CABundle
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the Security.CABundle. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. Specifies the group of CA certificate(s) that the client must use to validate the certificate presented by the remote server. These CA certificates form a trust chain that the server certificate must match, ensuring that only servers with trusted certificates can establish a connection. This parameter supports multiple CA certificat...

parameters.name: CipherList
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each item in this list specifies a cipher that the TLS client is allowed to use. When an empty string the system defaults are used.

parameters.name: MessageRetryTime
parameters.desc: Message retry time in seconds defines the wait time before a MQTT message that expects a response (QoS value of message is > 0, or PUBLISH, PUBREL, SUBSCRIBE, UNSUBSCRIBE message) is resent, because the response is not received (see [ Section 4.2/MQTT311 ]. This parameter only applies if ProtocolVersion is set to 3.1 .

parameters.name: ConnectRetryTime
parameters.desc: Connect retry time in seconds defines the wait time before a failed bridge connection is retried. A failure can either be on the connection level (e.g. the TCP/IP or TLS connection can not be established) or on the Protocol level, the MQTT client does not receive a MQTT CONNACK packet on a MQTT CONNECT packet sent.

parameters.name: ServerSelectionAlgorithm
parameters.desc: The algorithm used to select a server entry from the Server table Enumeration of: Priority (Select the server from the Server. table according to the sequence defined with the Server.{i}.Priority and Server.{i}.Weight values) RoundRobin (Select the servers round robin) Random (Select the servers randomly)

parameters.name: ServerConnection
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of the Server. instance that is used for this Bridge , while the Status is Connecting or Connected . If the MQTT bridge is not connected the value MUST be an empty string. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string.

parameters.name: ServerNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Server table.

parameters.name: SubscriptionNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Subscription table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables this Server .

If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. parameters.name: Priority
parameters.desc: The priority of this Server that is used by the Bridge when determining the Server to connect to. The Bridge MUST contact the Server with the lowest-numbered priority that the Bridge can reach as defined in [ RFC2782 ]. The selection of Server s with the same Priority value utilizes the Weight parameter to determine which Server is selected by the Bridge . This value is only used if Bridge.{i}.ServerSelectionAlgorithm is set to Priority .

parameters.name: Weight
parameters.desc: This parameter specifies a relative weight for entries with the same Priority . The mechanism is defined in [ RFC2782 ]. A value of -1 indicates that the implementation of this parameter is specific to the Vendor. This value is only used if Bridge.{i}.ServerSelectionAlgorithm is set to Priority .

parameters.name: IPVersion
parameters.desc: Specifies the IP protocol version, following the definitions in [ IANA-ipversionnumbers ]. Valid values are: 4 (IPv4), 6 (IPv6), or -1 (No specific IP version is required).

parameters.name: Address
parameters.desc: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) or IP address of the MQTT broker server this Bridge connects to. If the value of this parameter is a FQDN that resolves to multiple addresses then each address SHOULD be attempted (in an implementation-specific order) until a connection can be made or all addresses are exhausted, in which case the next Server instance (based on rules defined over the selected Bridge.{i}.ServerSelectionAlgorithm ) SHOULD be used. If the value of this parameter is an host name...

parameters.name: Port
parameters.desc: Port number of the MQTT broker server this Bridge connects to.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Setting Enable to true activates the handling of this subscription instance. In case of incoming directions ( Direction is either in or both ) the topic is subscribed over the bridge at the remote MQTT broker with a MQTT SUBSCRIBE message if Enable is set to true or unsubscribed from the remote MQTT broker with a MQTT UNSUBSCRIBE message if the value is set to false . The actual status of the subscription is indicated with Status .

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: Indicates the status of this subscription. Enumeration of: Enabled Disabled Error The Enabled value indicates that the this subscription is active. In case of incoming directions ( Direction is either in or both ) the topic was successfully subscribed with the remote MQTT broker. The Disabled value indicates that this subscription is not used. The Error value indicates that an error occurred (e.g. an subscription could not be made with the remote MQTT broker) and the subscription is not in use.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.desc: Name of the subscribed topic. Topic names may contain wildcards according to the rules specified in [ Section Appendix A/MQTT311 ], [ Section 4.7/MQTT311 ] or [ Section 4.7/MQTT50 ]. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with Direction ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.desc: The direction of the subscription. Enumeration of: out (Indicates that all matching topics will be sent over the bridge to the next MQTT broker) in (Indicates that all matching topics will be received over the bridge from the next MQTT broker) both (Indicates that all matching topics will be sent and received over the bridge) . If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with Topic ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: QoS
parameters.desc: The MQTT QoS level assigned with the subscription (see [ Section 4.1/MQTT311 ], [ Section 4.3/MQTT311 ]) or [ Section 4.3/MQTT50 ].

parameters.name: LocalPrefix
parameters.desc: The local prefix is used for remapping received topics to the local topics of the MQTT broker and to select the topics to be sent over bridge to the remote MQTT broker. In incoming direction ( Direction is either in or both ): For remote topics received over the bridge the MQTT broker adds the LocalPrefix in front of the received topic, before processing it. Example: Topic is "/bus/+", LocalPrefix is "/local", Direction is "in" MQTT broker receives message with topic "/bus/tr181" over bridge ...

parameters.name: RemotePrefix
parameters.desc: The remote prefix is used for remapping topics to the remote MQTT broker topic lists. In incoming direction ( Direction is either in or both ): For remote topics received over the bridge the MQTT broker removes the remote prefix topic from the received topic (before handling the LocalPrefix ), before processing it. Example: Topic is "/bus/+", LocalPrefix is "/local", RemotePrefix is "/remote", Direction is "in" MQTT broker receives message with topic "/remote/bus/tr181" over bridge => MQTT br...

parameters.name: TotalNumberOfClients
parameters.desc: Total number of MQTT clients registered with the MQTT broker.

parameters.name: NumberOfActiveClients
parameters.desc: Number of MQTT clients, which have a connection with the MQTT broker established.

parameters.name: NumberOfInactiveClients
parameters.desc: Number of MQTT clients, which have no connection with the MQTT broker established.

parameters.name: Subscriptions
parameters.desc: Number of subscriptions held by the MQTT broker. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PublishSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of publish messages sent by the MQTT broker. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PublishReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Number of publish messages received by the MQTT broker. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Total number of MQTT messages sent by the MQTT broker. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MQTTMessagesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Total number of MQTT messages received by the MQTT broker. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ConnectionErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Number of connection errors. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PublishErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Number of errors which prevented sending publish messages

The LastError parameter is updated with the detail of this error) Disabled (The Client...

If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with Username ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.desc: The IP interface over which update queries to the server are sent. If the value is an empty string, the CPE MUST use its routing policy (IP Forwarding table entries), if necessary, to determine the appropriate interface. The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the IP.Interface. table, or the Path Name of an interface layered above such a row, e.g., a row in the Logical.Interface. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string.

parameters.name: IPVersion
parameters.desc: Specifies the IP protocol version, following the definitions in [ IANA-ipversionnumbers ]. Valid values are: 4 (IPv4), 6 (IPv6), or -1 (No specific IP version is required). This indicates whether to update the A records (4), AAAA records (6) or both (-1).

parameters.name: Username
parameters.desc: Username used by this Dynamic DNS Client to authenticate with the Server. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that (together with Server ) doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.desc: Password used by this Dynamic DNS Client to authenticate with the Server. When read, this parameter returns an empty string, regardless of the actual value, unless the Controller has a "secured" role.

parameters.name: HostnameNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Hostname table.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: Fully qualified domain name that has to be updated with the IP address. If the name is set to another value, the Client MUST immediately send an update request to the Server. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on creation, the Agent MUST choose an initial value that doesn't conflict with any existing entries.

parameters.name: LastUpdate
parameters.desc: The date time of the last successful update of this name to the Dynamic DNS Server.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.desc: Dynamic DNS service used to contact this server. The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the Device.DynamicDNS.SupportedServices parameter.

parameters.name: ServerAddress
parameters.desc: Host name or IP address of the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: ServerPort
parameters.desc: Port number of the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: SupportedProtocols
parameters.desc: Indicates the protocols that are supported by the CPE for sending requests to the Dynamic DNS server. Comma-separated list of strings. This list depends on the Dynamic DNS service defined by the ServiceName parameter. Each list item is an enumeration of: HTTP (As defined in [ RFC2616 ]) HTTPS (As defined in [ RFC2818 ])

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.desc: The value MUST be a member of the list reported by the SupportedProtocols parameter. Indicates the protocol used to send requests to the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: CheckInterval
parameters.desc: Interval (in seconds ) between two checks for IP change. A value of zero indicates that the CPE knows when IP changes and doesn’t need to check it periodically.

parameters.name: RetryInterval
parameters.desc: Initial retry interval (in seconds ) after a failed request. This parameter can be used as a fixed value or as part of a retry interval calculation.

parameters.name: MaxRetries
parameters.desc: Maximum number of retries after a failed request. When the maximum number is reached, no further requests are sent until the context changes. A value of 0 means that there are no retries after a failed request.

parameters.name: BrightnessLimiter
parameters.desc: The maximum allowed brightness level for all LEDs, expressed as a percentage . This value is relative to the maximum allowed brightness value of each LED, which is specified in LED.{i}.MaxBrightness . Valid values are: 0 percentage to 100 percentage (The value 0 indicates that all LEDs are turned off, while the value 100 indicates the maximum brightness).

This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Switches on or off the power of the LED.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The internal name used to identify this LED.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: The status of the LED. Enumeration of: Disabled (The LED is currently not in use) InUse (The LED is currently being used by the CPE) Controlled (Indicates that the LED is under the control of the ControllingPeripheral ) Error (The LED status cannot be determined by the CPE)

parameters.name: Reason
parameters.desc: The textual purpose that represents the visual display of the LED (e.g., Broadband Down). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ControllingPeripheral
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a table row. Indicates which interface or peripheral this LED is controlled by. For example, 'Device.Ethernet.Interface.1'. If an empty string, the LED is not controlled by a specific peripheral.

parameters.name: CyclePeriodRepetitions
parameters.desc: The number of cycle periods left for this LED. As each cycle period is completed this parameter is reduced by 1. A value of -1 indicates an infinite number of cycle period repetitions. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: Location

parameters.name: RelativeXPosition
parameters.desc: The relative x position of the LED from left to right (x) and top to bottom (y) as the user looks at the device from the orientation identified in the Location parameter in its typical orientation (e.g., on-end, flat).

parameters.name: RelativeYPosition
parameters.desc: The relative y position of the LED from left to right (x) and top to bottom (y) as the user looks at the device from the orientation identified in the Location parameter in its typical orientation (e.g., on-end, flat).

parameters.name: MaxBrightness

parameters.name: Color

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.desc: The duration, in milliseconds , for this element of the cycle period.

parameters.name: FadeInterval
parameters.desc: The interval corresponding to this CycleElement instance, in milliseconds , from the starting from the target illumination characteristics of the previous CycleElement instance to the target illumination characteristics of this CycleElement instance. The transition to the target illumination characteristics is uniformly interpolated "perceptually" over the value of this FadeInterval parameter.

parameters.name: Brightness

If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. If the LED instances does not have a current cycle element active, this parameter MUST be set to an empty string. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: OperationalDomain
parameters.desc: This parameter describes the operational domain for this measurement endpoint

parameters.name: InternetDomain

parameters.name: UseMeasurementEndpointInReports
parameters.desc: If the value of this parameter is false then the Measurement Endpoint MUST not be included in measurement reports.

parameters.name: ReferencePoint
parameters.desc: This parameter describes the measurement reference point of the measurement endpoint. Enumeration of: STP (Internet Source Test Point) IDTP (Internet Drain Test Point) RNTP (Regional Network Test Point) IRTP (Internal Regional Test Point) MTP (Metro Test Point) IATP (Internal Access Test Point) UNITP (User Network Interface Test Point) CEDTP (Customer End Device Test Point)

parameters.name: GeographicalLocation
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a DeviceInfo.Location object that describes the geographic location of the measurement endpoint. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string.

parameters.name: EquipmentIdentifier

parameters.desc: If the value of the MeasurementPoint parameter is not an empty string and the value of this parameter is false then the value of the MeasurementPoint parameter MUST not be included in measurement reports.

One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DiscardPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of inbound packets which were chosen to be discarded even though no errors had been detected to prevent their being delivered. One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested for transmission and which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnicastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were not addressed to a multicast or broadcast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested for transmission and which were addressed to a broadcast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were addressed to a broadcast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnknownProtoPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of packets received via the interface which were discarded because of an unknown or unsupported protocol. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.desc: The ID as assigned by the CPE to this SoftwareImage entry. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.desc: A string identifying the software version. This parameter is based on Version from [ Section 9.1.4/G.988 ].

parameters.name: IsCommitted
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates whether or not the associated software image is committed. This parameter is based on Is committed from [ Section 9.1.4/G.988 ].

parameters.name: IsActive
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates whether the associated software image is active ( true ) or inactive ( false ). This parameter is based on Is active from [ Section 9.1.4/G.988 ].

parameters.name: IsValid
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates whether the associated software image is valid ( true ) or invalid ( false ). This parameter is based on Is valid from [ Section 9.1.4/G.988 ].

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables the interface. If disabled, the device should force the ONU state of this ANI to O1 (Initial state). This parameter is based on ifAdminStatus from [ RFC2863 ]. Note: forcing the state to O1 implies the device disables the TX laser of the associated transceiver(s). It's not required to disable the RX part of the transceivers as well.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: The current operational state of the interface. Although this object is not an interface object, it follows largely the conventions of [ Section 4.2.2/TR-181i2 ]. The most important deviation is that LowerLayerDown is not a valid value. Enumeration of: Up Down Unknown Dormant NotPresent Error (OPTIONAL) NotAllowed (Added in 2.21) When Enable is false then Status SHOULD normally be Down (or NotPresent or Error if there is a fault condition on the interface). When Enable becomes true then Statu...

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT c...

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The textual name of the ANI entry as assigned by the CPE. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.desc: The accumulated time in seconds since the interface entered its current operational state. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PONMode
parameters.desc: PON mode, defines the detected or configured PON mode of the ANI. Enumeration of: Unknown G-PON XG-PON NG-PON2 XGS-PON Transceiver has a parameter of the same name. For proper operation, the PON mode of the transceiver(s) corresponding to this ANI must be equal to the PON mode of this ANI. But a user might e.g. accidentally insert a G-PON SFP while the PON mode of the ANI is XGS-PON.

parameters.name: TransceiverNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Transceiver table.

parameters.name: SFPReferenceList
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings (maximum number of characters per item 256). Each list item MUST be the Path Name of a row in the SFPs.SFPCage. table, or an empty string. Small-form Factor Pluggable (SFP) entries associated with this interface.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes transmitted out of the interface, including framing characters. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received on the interface, including framing characters. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames transmitted out of the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames received on the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of outbound Ethernet frames that could not be transmitted because of errors. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of inbound Ethernet frames that contained errors preventing them from being forwarded to the UNI(s). Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnicastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames requested for transmission which were not addressed to a multicast or broadcast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnicastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames, forwarded by this interface to the UNI(s), which were not addressed to a multicast or broadcast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DiscardPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of outbound Ethernet frames which were chosen to be discarded even though no errors had been detected to prevent their being transmitted. One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DiscardPacketsReceived

One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames requested for transmission and which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received Ethernet frames, forwarded by this interface to the UNI(s), which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of Ethernet frames requested for transmission on the PON and which were addressed to a broadcast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsReceived

parameters.name: UnknownProtoPacketsReceived

parameters.name: ONUState
parameters.desc: ONU activation state. Enumeration of: O1 O2 O3 O2-3 O4 O5 O6 O7 O8 O9 See: [ Section C.12/G.9807.1 ] [ Section 10/G.984.3 ] [ Section 12/G.987.3 ] [ Section 12/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: VendorID
parameters.desc: Identifies the vendor of the ONU. See [ Section 9.1.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.desc: Represents the combination of the Vendor-ID and the Vendor-specific serial number (VSSN). The parameter shows the serial number in a human readable format. Example: if the vendor ID is ABCD and the VSSN encodes the number 1234568, the value of this parameter is ABCD12345678. See [ Section 9.1.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: ONUID
parameters.desc: Identifier that the OLT assigns to this ANI during the activation. See: [ Section C.6.1.5.6/G.9807.1 ] [ Section 5.5.2/G.984.3 ] [ Section 6.4.2/G.987.3 ] [ Section 6.1.5.6/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: Password
parameters.desc: All ITU based PON standards specify authentication by PLOAM password or registration ID. See: [ Section C.15.2.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Section VI.2/G.984.3 ] [ Section 15.2.1/G.987.3 ] [ Section 15.2.1/G.989.3 ] All those standards mention that a method to enter the password is beyond their scope. This parameter and the parameter HexadecimalPassword standardize a method to enter the password. In case of G-PON as PON mode, the password can be up to 10 bytes long. See [ Section 9.2.4.2/G.984.3 ]. For th...

parameters.name: HexadecimalPassword
parameters.desc: If false , Password is in ASCII format. If true , Password is in hexadecimal format. See Password for more info.

parameters.name: CorrectedFECBytes
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The number of bytes that were corrected by the FEC function. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: CorrectedFECCodewords
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Count of FEC codewords that contained errors but were corrected by the FEC function. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: UncorrectableFECCodewords
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Count of FEC codewords that contained errors and could not be corrected by the FEC function. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: TotalFECCodewords
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Count of total received FEC codewords. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: PSBdHECErrorCount
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] HEC error in any of the fields of PSBd. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: HeaderHECErrorCount
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] HEC errors received in the DS XGTC or FS header. This counter is called: "FS HEC error count" in [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] and [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]. "XGTC HEC error count" in [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ]. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: UnknownProfile
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] ONU could not transmit because the specified burst profile was not known. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: FramesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Total number of (X)GEM frames transmitted. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: FramesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Total number of (X)GEM frames received. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: FrameHeaderHECErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] XGEM frame header HEC errors. Number of events involving loss of XGEM channel delineation. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: KeyErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] XGEM key errors. XGEM frames discarded because of unknown or invalid encryption key. Examples include: no unicast or broadcast key established for specified key index, key index indicating encrypted XGEM frame on a XGEM port that is not provisioned for encryption, key index indicating upstream encryption on a XGEM port that is provisioned for downstream encryption only, or invalid key index (11). This count is included in FramesReceived . See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Ta...

parameters.name: MICErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] PLOAM MIC errors. Counter of received PLOAM messages with MIC errors. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: DownstreamMessageCount
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Downstream PLOAM message count. Count of PLOAM messages sent by OLT, received by ONU, either broadcast or directed to the specific ONU-ID. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: RangingTime
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Count of Ranging_Time PLOAM messages sent by OLT. It provides a base for transmission time drift estimation. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: UpstreamMessageCount
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] Upstream PLOAM message count. Count of messages (other than Acknowledgement) sent by ONU to OLT. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: BaselineMessagesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] OMCI baseline message count. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ] Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ExtendedMessagesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] OMCI extended message count. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ] Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MICErrors
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] Count of received OMCI messages with MIC errors. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ] Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PortNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Port table.

parameters.name: PortID
parameters.desc: Identifies a GEM port. See: [ Section C.6.1.5.8/G.9807.1 ] [ Section 5.5.5/G.984.3 ] [ Section 6.4.4/G.987.3 ] [ Section 6.1.5.8/G.989.3 ] This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.desc: Type of connection this GEM port is used for. Enumeration of: UNI-to-ANI ANI-to-UNI bidirectional See: [ Section 9.2.3/G.988 ].

parameters.name: PortType
parameters.desc: GEM port type. Enumeration of: unicast multicast broadcast

parameters.name: FramesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] (X)GEM frames transmitted by this (X)GEM port. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: FramesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] (X)GEM frames received by this (X)GEM port. See: [ Table C.14.1/G.9807.1 ] [ Table 14-1/G.987.3 ] [ Table 14-1/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: SignalFail
parameters.desc: Signal fail (SF) threshold. This parameter specifies the downstream bit error rate (BER) threshold to detect the SF alarm. When this value is y, the BER threshold is 10^-y^. This parameter is based on Signal fail (SF) threshold from [ Section 9.2.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: SignalDegrade
parameters.desc: Signal degrade (SD) threshold. This parameter specifies the downstream BER threshold to detect the SD alarm. When this value is x, the BER threshold for SD is 10^-x^. The SD threshold must be lower than the SF threshold; i.e., x > y. This parameter is based on Signal degrade (SD) threshold from [ Section 9.2.1/G.988 ].

parameters.name: LOS
parameters.desc: Loss of signal. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: LOF
parameters.desc: Loss of frame. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: SF
parameters.desc: Signal failed. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: SD
parameters.desc: Signal degraded. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: LCDG
parameters.desc: Loss of GEM channel delineation. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: TF
parameters.desc: Transmitter failure. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: SUF
parameters.desc: Start-up failure. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: MEM
parameters.desc: Message error message. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: DACT
parameters.desc: Deactivate ONU-ID. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: DIS
parameters.desc: Disabled ONU. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: MIS
parameters.desc: Link mismatching. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: PEE
parameters.desc: When the ONU receives a PEE message. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: RDI
parameters.desc: Remote defect indication. See [ Section 11.1.2/G.984.3 ].

parameters.name: LODS
parameters.desc: Loss of downstream synchronization. See [ G.9807.1 ].

parameters.name: ROGUE
parameters.desc: The ANI behaves rogue: it is not transmitting in a manner consistent with parameters specified in the ITU-T PON standards. Hence it can threaten all upstream transmissions on the PON, causing interference and disrupting communications of other ONUs on the PON. An example of rogue behavior is transmitting in the wrong timeslot. See: [ Section C.19/G.9807.1 ] [ Section 19/G.989.3 ]

parameters.name: ID
parameters.desc: The ID as assigned by the CPE to this Transceiver entry. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Identifier
parameters.desc: Transceiver type. Allowed values are given by [ Table 4-1/SFF-8024 ].

parameters.name: VendorName
parameters.desc: Vendor name. See [ Table 4-1/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: VendorPartNumber
parameters.desc: Vendor part number. See "Vendor PN" in [ Table 4-1/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: VendorRevision
parameters.desc: Vendor revision. See "Vendor rev" in [ Table 4-1/SFF-8472 ].

parameters.name: PONMode
parameters.desc: PON mode, reports the PON mode of the transceiver. Enumeration of: Unknown G-PON XG-PON NG-PON2 XGS-PON

parameters.name: Connector
parameters.desc: Connector type. Enumeration of: Unknown LC (Lucent Connector, Little Connector, or Local Connector) SC (Subscriber connector, square connector or standard connector) ST (Straight tip connector) FC (Ferrule Connector or Fiber Channel) MT-RJ (Mechanical Transfer Registered Jack)

parameters.name: NominalBitRateDownstream
parameters.desc: Nominal data rate downstream in kbps .

parameters.name: NominalBitRateUpstream
parameters.desc: Nominal data rate upstream in kbps .

parameters.name: RxPower
parameters.desc: Measured RX power in 0.1 dBm .

parameters.name: TxPower
parameters.desc: Measured TX power in 0.1 dBm .

parameters.name: Voltage
parameters.desc: Measured supply voltage in mV .

parameters.name: Bias
parameters.desc: Measured bias current in µA .

parameters.name: Temperature
parameters.desc: Measured temperature in degrees celsius . A value of -274 (which is below absolute zero) indicates a good reading has not been obtained.

parameters.name: PowerReductionManagementCapability
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. This parameter indicates the sleep mode capability of the PowerManagement . This parameter is based on [ Section 9.1.14 ONU dynamic power management control/G.988 ]. An an empty string string indicates that no capabilities are supported. Each list item is an enumeration of: WatchfulSleepMode DozeMode CyclicSleepMode

parameters.name: OLTSleepAllow
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates that the ONU is allowed, by the OLT, to apply the power reduction mode.

parameters.name: PowerReductionManagementStatus
parameters.desc: This parameter indicates the current power reduction management status of the ONU. The ONU can be in one of the following states: Enumeration of: Active (The ONU is fully operational and not in a low power state) WatchfulSleepMode (The ONU is in Low Power Watchful Sleep Mode) DozeMode (The ONU is in Low Power Doze Mode) CyclicSleepMode (The ONU is in Low Power Sleep Mode) .

parameters.name: ITransInit
parameters.desc: Optical Network Unit (ONU) vendor's statement of the complete transceiver initialization time: the worst-case time required for the ONU to regain full functionality when leaving the asleep state (i.e., turning on both the receiver and the transmitter and acquiring synchronization to the downstream flow), measured in units of 125 microsecond PHY frames . The value zero indicates that the sleeping ONU can respond to a bandwidth grant without delay. Reference [ Section 9.1.14 ONU dynamic power m...

parameters.name: ITxInit
parameters.desc: This parameter is the Optical Network Unit (ONU) vendor's statement of the transmitter initialization time: the time required for the ONU to regain full functionality when leaving the listen state (i.e., turning on the transmitter), measured in units of 125 microsecond PHY frames . The value zero indicates that the dozing ONU can respond to a bandwidth grant without delay. Reference [ Section 9.1.14 ONU dynamic power management control/G.988 ]

parameters.name: MaxSleepInterval
parameters.desc: The Isleep/Ilowpower attribute specifies the maximum time the ONU spends in its asleep, listen, or low-power states, as a count of 125 microsecond PHY frames . Local or remote events may truncate the ONU's sojourn in these states. The default value of this attribute is 0.

parameters.name: MinAwareInterval
parameters.desc: The Iaware attribute specifies the time the ONU spends in its aware state, as a count of 125 microsecond PHY frames , before it re-enters asleep or listen states. Local or remote events may independently cause the ONU to enter an active state rather than returning to a sleep state. The default value of this attribute is 0. Reference [ Section 9.1.14 ONU dynamic power management control/G.988 ]

parameters.name: MinActiveHeldInterval
parameters.desc: The Ihold attribute specifies the minimum time during which the ONU remains in the active held state, as a count of 125 microsecond PHY frames . Its initial value is zero. Reference [ Section 9.1.14 ONU dynamic power management control/G.988 ]

parameters.name: MaxSleepIntervalExtension
parameters.desc: This parameter designates maximum sleep interval values for doze mode and cyclic sleep mode separately. When it supports this attribute, the ONU ignores the value of the maximum sleep interval attribute. Maximum sleep interval for doze mode and cyclic sleep mode are both 4 bytes. Maximum sleep interval for doze mode specifies the maximum time the ONU spends in its listen state, as a count of 125 microsecond PHY frames . Local or remote events may truncate the ONU's sojourn in these states. Th...

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables the SSH service.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: The status of the SSH service. Enumeration of: Disabled (Indicates that the SSH service is disabled) Enabled (Indicates that the SSH service is enabled) Error (Indicates that the SSH service has encountered an error, OPTIONAL)

parameters.name: ServerNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the Server table.

parameters.name: AuthorizedKeyNumberOfEntries
parameters.desc: The number of entries in the AuthorizedKey table.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.desc: Enables or disables the SSH server instance. When Enable is set to false , any active sessions must be forcibly terminated and the ActivationDate is reset.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.desc: The status of the SSH server instance. Enumeration of: Disabled (Indicates that the SSH server instance is disabled) Enabled (Indicates that the SSH server instance is enabled) Error (Indicates that the SSH server instance has encountered an error, OPTIONAL) Error_Misconfigured (Indicates that a necessary configuration value is undefined or invalid)

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.desc: [ Alias ] A non-volatile unique key used to reference this instance. Alias provides a mechanism for a Controller to label this instance for future reference. The following mandatory constraints MUST be enforced: The value MUST NOT be empty. The value MUST start with a letter. If the value is not assigned by the Controller at creation time, the Agent MUST assign a value with an "cpe-" prefix. Once it's been set, this parameter is immutable. If the value isn't assigned by the Controller on crea...

parameters.name: Interface
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the IP.Interface. table, or the Path Name of an interface layered above such a row, e.g., a row in the Logical.Interface. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. The IP Interface associated with the Server entry. If an empty string is specified, the service should listen on all interfaces.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.desc: Specify the port used by the SSH server.

parameters.name: IdleTimeout
parameters.desc: When the session is inactive, it is automatically terminated after IdleTimeout amount of seconds . A value of 0 disables this feature.

parameters.name: KeepAlive
parameters.desc: Every amount of KeepAlive seconds a keep alive message is sent. A value of 0 disables this feature.

parameters.name: AllowRootLogin
parameters.desc: Permit SSH users to login as root.

parameters.name: AllowPasswordLogin
parameters.desc: Permit SSH users to login using a password.

parameters.name: AllowRootPasswordLogin
parameters.desc: Permit the root SSH user to login using a password.

parameters.name: MaxAuthTries
parameters.desc: Maximum authentication tries allowed before disconnect

parameters.name: BanTime
parameters.desc: The time, in seconds , that an IP address is banned after exceeding the MaxAuthTries . A value of 0 disables this feature.

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv4
parameters.desc: Allow incoming IP connections from any IPv4 address. The source prefixes defined in IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Allow only incoming IP connections from the provided list of IPv4 prefixes. When IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix is set to an empty string and AllowAllIPv4 is set to false , no incoming IP connections are allowed. When AllowAllIPv4 is set true , IPv4AllowedSourcePrefix is ignored.

parameters.name: AllowAllIPv6
parameters.desc: Allow incoming IP connections from any IPv6 address. The source prefixes defined in IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix will be ignored.

parameters.name: IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Allow only incoming IP connections from the provided list of IPv6 prefixes. When IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix is set to an empty string and AllowAllIPv6 is set to false , no incoming IP connections are allowed. When AllowAllIPv6 is set true , IPv6AllowedSourcePrefix is ignored.

parameters.name: ActivationDate
parameters.desc: Activation date indicates when the server instance has been activated and the Enable is set to true .

parameters.name: AutoDisableDuration
parameters.desc: The SSH server instance will be disabled when the the AutoDisableDuration elapses, and configuration must be done in minutes . At the end, the corresponding Enable parameter of the SSH server instance is automatically changed to false false . parameters.name: Interface
parameters.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the IP.Interface. table, or the Path Name of an interface layered above such a row, e.g., a row in the Logical.Interface. table. If the referenced object is deleted, the parameter value MUST be set to an empty string. This parameter specifies the interface to be monitored. Typically this is the WAN interface.

parameters.name: MonitorInterval
parameters.desc: The interval at which the Device monitors the connection status of the interface, in second .

parameters.name: FailInterval
parameters.desc: The interval at which the Device checks for connection failures after the initial monitor interval, in second .

parameters.name: MaxResponseTimeout
parameters.desc: The maximum time the Device waits for a response after sending a connectivity test packet, in second .

parameters.name: NumberOfAttempts
parameters.desc: The current number of failed attempts when no reply is obtained. This parameter is reset to zero when the last Action has been executed or when a connectivity test succeeds.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.desc: The connectivity test method to be performed on the Interface . Enumeration of: ARP (Tests Layer 2 connectivity for IPv4 by sending an ARP Request to the default gateway. A successful ARP Reply from the gateway is required to pass the test) ND (Tests Layer 2 connectivity for IPv6 by sending a Neighbor Solicitation (NS) message to the default gateway. A successful Neighbor Advertisement (NA) response is required to pass the test) Ping (Tests Layer 3 connectivity by sending ICMP Echo Request pa...

parameters.name: IPVersion
parameters.desc: Specifies the IP protocol version, following the definitions in [ IANA-ipversionnumbers ]. Valid values are: 4 (IPv4), 6 (IPv6), or -1 (No specific IP version is required).

parameters.name: DestAddress
parameters.desc: The destination address (IP address or FQDN) to which connectivity test packets are sent. When IPVersion is set to '-1',the implementation will chose and use only one IP version for testing the connectivity. It will try to use IPv6 first, and if that fails, it will fall back to IPv4. When Method is set to ARP or ND this parameter specifies the IP address of the network device under test. The Device will send ARP requests (for IPv4) or Neighbor Solicitation messages (for IPv6) to this address ...

parameters.name: DSCPMark
parameters.desc: Diffserv code point to be used for outgoing connection monitoring traffic.

parameters.name: EthernetPriority
parameters.desc: The Ethernet Priority for this Connection entry, also known as 802.1p Priority, is a 3-bit field used to indicate the priority of network traffic. A value of -1 indicates that the Ethernet priority should not be changed for this Connection .

parameters.name: MonitoringStatus
parameters.desc: The current monitoring status of the connection. Enumeration of: Up (Indicates that the monitored connection is currently up and responsive) Unresponsive (Indicates that the monitored connection is currently unresponsive, meaning that connectivity tests have failed)

parameters.name: Name
parameters.desc: The textual name of the interface as assigned by the CPE. The Agent MUST choose an initial value that doesn't conflict with any existing entries. This is a non-functional key and its value MUST NOT change once it's been set internally by the Agent.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.desc: A user-friendly description of the interface.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.desc: The accumulated time in seconds since the interface entered its current operational state. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: LowerLayers
parameters.desc: Comma-separated list (maximum number of characters 1024) of strings. Each list item MUST be the Path Name of an interface object that is stacked immediately below this interface object, or an empty string. See [ Section 4.2.1/TR-181i2 ].

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes transmitted out of the interface, including framing characters. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received on the interface, including framing characters. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets transmitted out of the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received on the interface. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of inbound packets that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnicastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets requested for transmission which were not addressed to a multicast or broadcast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DiscardPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of outbound packets which were chosen to be discarded even though no errors had been detected to prevent their being transmitted. One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: DiscardPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of inbound packets which were chosen to be discarded even though no errors had been detected to prevent their being delivered. One possible reason for discarding such a packet could be to free up buffer space. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested for transmission and which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnicastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were not addressed to a multicast or broadcast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: MulticastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were addressed to a multicast address at this layer. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets that higher-level protocols requested for transmission and which were addressed to a broadcast address at this layer, including those that were discarded or not sent. Note that IPv6 does not define broadcast addresses, so IPv6 packets will never cause this counter to increment. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BroadcastPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of received packets , delivered by this layer to a higher layer, which were addressed to a broadcast address at this layer. Note that IPv6 does not define broadcast addresses, so IPv6 packets will never cause this counter to increment. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: UnknownProtoPacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of packets received via the interface which were discarded because of an unknown or unsupported protocol. Value Change Notification requests for this parameter MAY be denied.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes sent by the tunnel.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received by the tunnel.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets sent by the tunnel.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received by the tunnel.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets discarded by the tunnel due to any error. This can include packets dropped due to a lack of transmit buffers.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received by the tunnel that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.

parameters.desc: The base64 encoded pre-shared key for this WireGuard Peer. When an empty string is provided, no pre-shared key is used. When read, this parameter returns an empty string, regardless of the actual value, unless the Controller has a "secured" role.

parameters.name: AllowedIPs
parameters.desc: [ IPAddress ] Comma-separated list of IP Addresses. Each item represents an IPv4/v6 subnets in CIDR notation from which incoming traffic is allowed and to which outgoing traffic is directed for this peer. '0.0.0.0/0' maybe specified for matching all IPv4 addresses and '::/0' for matching all IPv6 addresses. When an empty string is provided, no traffic is routed to this peer.

parameters.name: EndpointAddress
parameters.desc: The remote network address (IP or hostname) of the peer. An empty string indicates that the endpoint address is not used.

parameters.name: EndpointPort
parameters.desc: The UDP port of the remote peer. A value of -1 indicates that the endpoint port is not used.

parameters.name: PersistentKeepalive
parameters.desc: An interval in seconds to send an authenticated empty packet to the peer. This is useful for keeping NAT mappings alive. A value of 0 disables this feature.

parameters.name: LastHandshakeTime
parameters.desc: The amount of time in seconds since the last handshake was sent with this peer.

parameters.name: EndpointID
