Enumeration of: Associated (STA associated with a BSS operated by the Multi-AP Agent) Not_Associated (STA not associated with any BSS operated by the Multi-AP Agent) Capability_Report_Failure (Client capability report unspecified failure) Reject_Channel (Backhaul steering request rejected because the backhaul STA cannot operate on the channel specified) Reject_Weak (Backhaul steering request rejected because ...

events.name: Associated!
events.desc: The event is generated when an Associated Device (STA) associates to a BSS.

output.name: TimeStamp
output.desc: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

output.name: BSSID
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Association Event.

output.name: MACAddress
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] If a MLD, the MAC Address of the STA MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: StatusCode
output.desc: The status code sent to the Associated Device (STA) in the Association Response frame as defined by [ Table 9-50/802.11-2020 ].

output.name: HTCapabilities
output.desc: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). Uses the format defined by the AP HTCapabilities TLV [ Section 17.2.8/EasyMesh ]. Includes all fields in the AP HTCapabilities TLV except tlvType, tlvLength, tlvValue and RUID.

output.name: VHTCapabilities
output.desc: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). Uses the format defined by the AP VHTCapabilities TLV [ Section 17.2.9/EasyMesh ]. Includes all fields in the AP VHTCapabilities TLV except tlvType, tlvLength, tlvValue and RUID.

output.name: ClientCapabilities
output.desc: The frame body of the (Re)Association Request frame received from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of [ 802.11-2020 ] in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

output.name: OpClass
output.desc: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]. May be determined from [ Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV/EasyMesh ] and the Supported Operating Classes element in [ Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV/EasyMesh ]. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

output.name: Channel
output.desc: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from [ Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV/EasyMesh ] and the Supported Operating Classes element in [ Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV/EasyMesh ]. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

output.name: WiFi6Capabilities.
output.desc: Describes the Wi-Fi 6 capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: HE160
output.desc: Indicates support for High Efficiency (HE) 160 MHz.

output.name: HE8080
output.desc: Indicates support for HE 80+80 MHz.

output.name: MCSNSS
output.desc: Supported High Efficiency-Modulation and Coding Scheme (HE-MCS) and Number of Spatial Streams (NSS) Set field as defined in [ Figure 9-788d/802.11ax ] Supported HE-MCS And NSS Set field format. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 160MHz is present if 160MHz is supported. HE-MCS And NSS Set field for 80+80MHz is present if 80+80MHz is supported.

output.name: SUBeamformer
output.desc: Indicates support for Single-User (SU) Beamformer.

output.name: SUBeamformee
output.desc: Indicates support for SU Beamformee.

output.name: MUBeamformer
output.desc: Indicates support for Multi-User (MU) Beamformer.

output.name: Beamformee80orLess
output.desc: Indicates support for Beamformee Space-Time Stream (STS) ≤ 80 MHz.

output.name: BeamformeeAbove80
output.desc: Indicates support for Beamformee STS > 80 MHz.

output.name: ULMUMIMO
output.desc: Indicates support for Uplink (UL) Multi-User Multiple Input, Multiple Output (MU-MIMO).

output.name: ULOFDMA
output.desc: Indicates support for UL Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

output.name: DLOFDMA
output.desc: Indicates support for Downlink (DL) Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDMA).

output.name: MaxDLMUMIMO
output.desc: Max number of users supported per DL MU-MIMO Transmitter (TX) in the BSS role.

output.name: MaxULMUMIMO
output.desc: Max number of users supported per UL MU-MIMO Receiver (RX) in the BSS role.

output.name: MaxDLOFDMA
output.desc: Max number of users supported per Downlink (DL) OFDMA TX in the BSS role.

output.name: MaxULOFDMA
output.desc: Max number of users supported per UL OFDMA RX in the BSS role.

output.name: RTS
output.desc: Indicates support for Request To Send (RTS).

output.name: MURTS
output.desc: Indicates support for MU RTS.

output.name: MultiBSSID
output.desc: Indicates support for Multi-Basic Service Set Identifier (BSSID).

output.name: MUEDCA
output.desc: Indicates support for MU Enhanced distributed channel access (EDCA).

output.name: TWTRequestor
output.desc: Indicates support for Target Wake Time (TWT) Requestor.

output.name: TWTResponder
output.desc: Indicates support for TWT Responder.

output.name: SpatialReuse
output.desc: Indicates support for EasyMesh configuration and reporting of BSS Color and Spatial Reuse.

output.name: AnticipatedChannelUsage
output.desc: Indicates support for Anticipated Channel Usage (ACU) reporting.

events.name: Disassociated!
events.desc: The event is generated when an Associated Device (STA) disassociates from a BSS.

output.name: BSSID
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] If a MLD, the MAC Address of the AP MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the Disassociation Event.

output.name: MACAddress
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] If a MLD, the MAC Address of the STA MLD, otherwise the MAC Address of the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: ReasonCode
output.desc: The Reason Code received by the AP from the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame or sent by the AP to the Associated Device (STA) in the most recent Disassociation or Deauthentication frame as defined in [ Table 9-49/802.11-2020 ].

output.name: BytesSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device (STA). For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits .

output.name: BytesReceived
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device (STA). For Multi-AP Agents that implement Profile-1, the units of this counter are Bytes. Otherwise, the units of this counter are as specified by Device.WiFi.DataElements.Network.Device.{i}.Radio.{i}.BSS.{i}.ByteCounterUnits .

output.name: PacketsSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: PacketsReceived
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received from the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: ErrorsSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted to the Associated Device (STA) because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit or from other causes.

output.name: ErrorsReceived
output.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of inbound packets from the Associated Device (STA) that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol.

output.name: RetransCount
output.desc: [ StatsCounter32 ] The total number of transmitted packets to the Associated Device (STA) which were retransmissions. N retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by N.

output.name: TimeStamp
output.desc: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

output.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
output.desc: The data transmit rate in kbps that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: LastDataUplinkRate
output.desc: The data transmit rate in kbps that was most recently used for transmission of data from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point.

output.name: UtilizationReceive
output.desc: The amount of time in milliseconds that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: UtilizationTransmit
output.desc: The amount of time in milliseconds that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to the Associated Device (STA).

output.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
output.desc: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in Mbps achievable in the downlink direction to the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ].

output.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
output.desc: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in Mbps achievable in the uplink direction from the Associated Device (STA) if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ].

output.name: SignalStrength
output.desc: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the Associated Device (STA) to the access point - measured in dBm . RCPI is encoded per [ Table 9-176/802.11-2020 ], and described in [ Section 10.3.1/EasyMesh ]). Reserved: 221 - 255.

output.name: LastConnectTime
output.desc: The time in seconds since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

output.name: Noise
output.desc: An indicator of the average radio noise plus interference power at the access point measured for the primary operating channel to this Associated Device (STA). Encoded as defined for ANPI in [ Section 11.10.9.4/802.11-2020 ].

output.name: InitiatedBy
output.desc: This parameter indicates the entity that initiated this Disassociation Event. Enumeration of: STA EasyMesh_Agent EasyMesh_Controller DE_Collector Unknown

output.name: OpClass
output.desc: Operating class in use at the time of this event, from [ Table E-4/802.11ax ]. May be determined from [ Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV/EasyMesh ] and the Supported Operating Classes element in [ Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV/EasyMesh ]. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the operating class over which association messaging had occurred.

output.name: Channel
output.desc: The single channel number of the channel in use at the time of this event. May be determined from [ Table 17.2.17, Operating Channel Report TLV/EasyMesh ] and the Supported Operating Classes element in [ Table 17.2.19, Client Capability Report TLV/EasyMesh ]. For Multi-Link Operation (MLO) this is the channel over which association messaging had occurred.

output.name: DisassociationLinkStats.{i}.
output.desc: This object describes the final per link stats of each affiliated STA on disassociation. Applies only to Multi-Link Device (MLD) links. EasyMesh [ EasyMesh ] source: Affiliated STA Traffic Stats. This table's Instance Numbers MUST be 1, 2, 3... (assigned sequentially without gaps).

output.name: MACAddress
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] The MAC address of the affiliated STA whose link stats are being reported.

output.name: BytesSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes transmitted to the affiliated STA.

output.name: BytesReceived
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of bytes received from the affiliated STA.

output.name: PacketsSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets transmitted to the affiliated STA.

output.name: PacketsReceived
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The total number of packets received from the affiliated STA.

output.name: ErrorsSent
output.desc: [ StatsCounter64 ] The number of packets which could not be transmitted to the affiliated STA because of errors.

events.name: FailedConnection!
events.desc: The event is generated when an Associated Device (STA) fails to connect to a BSS.

output.name: BSSID
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] The MAC Address of the logical BSS (BSSID) which is reporting the failed connection event.

output.name: MACAddress
output.desc: [ MACAddress ] MAC Address identifying the associated device (STA) that has attempted to connect.

output.name: StatusCode
output.desc: Status Code set to a non-zero value that indicates the reason for association or authentication failure as defined in [ Table 9-50/802.11-2020 ], or Status Code set to zero and ReasonCode provided.

output.name: ReasonCode
output.desc: Reason Code indicating the reason the STA was disassociated or deauthenticated as defined in [ Table 9-49/802.11-2020 ].

output.name: TimeStamp
output.desc: The time this event happened. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in [ Section 3/RFC3339 ].

events.name: IPLayerCapacityIncrementalResult!
events.desc: This event provides a mechanism to deliver IPLayerCapacity incremental results to a USP Controller during the execution of the diagnostics test.

output.name: IPLayerCapacity
output.desc: Results of measurements using the maximum IP-Layer Capacity metric calculation for a single interval from [ TR-471 ] Equation 1, for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. Result is expressed in Mbps with 2 digits beyond the decimal. 10 6 bits/second = 1 Mbps .

output.name: TimeOfSubInterval
output.desc: Time in UTC of end of sub-interval when IPLayerCapacity was measured. Value MUST be specified to IPLayerCapacity().Input.TimestampResolution precision. For example: 2008-04-09T15:01:05.123456Z

output.name: LossRatio
output.desc: Ratio of lost packets to total packets, for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: RTTRange
output.desc: The range of Round Trip Time (RTT), for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. See [ TR-471 ] for description of how value is calculated. This value is expressed in seconds . This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: PDVRange
output.desc: The range of Packet Delay Variation (PDV), for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. See [ TR-471 ] for description of how value is calculated. This value is expressed in seconds . This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: MinOnewayDelay
output.desc: The minimum one-way delay, for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. The minimum one-way delay is calculated at the conclusion of the test and SHALL be calculated using the conditional distribution of all packets with a finite one-way delay value (undefined delays are excluded). This value is expressed in seconds . This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: ReorderedRatio
output.desc: Ratio of reordered packets to total packets, for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: ReplicatedRatio
output.desc: Ratio of replicated packets to total packets, for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval across all connections for this test. This value is expressed as a decimal to 9 decimal digits.

output.name: InterfaceEthMbps
output.desc: The number of bits observed on the IPLayerCapacity().Input.Interface during an IP-Layer Capacity test for time interval of duration IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval ending at TimeOfSubInterval , divided by the duration of IPLayerCapacity().Input.TestSubInterval . Result is expressed in Mbps with 2 digits beyond the decimal. 10 6 bits/second = 1 Mbps . This is primarily a diagnostic measurement. Measurement direction follows the IPLayerCapacity().Input.Role .

events.name: Push!
events.desc: Periodic Statistics Push event for delivering a periodic statistics report within a USP Notification message.

output.name: Parameter.{i}.
output.desc: Periodic statistics parameter table for the report sent by this event. This table contains entries for parameters whose values were sampled. This table's Instance Numbers MUST be 1, 2, 3... (assigned sequentially without gaps). At most one entry in this table can exist with a given value for Reference .

output.name: Reference
output.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a parameter. This is the parameter being reported by the Periodic Statistics mechanism.

output.name: Values
output.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each entry indicates the value of the referenced parameter, as determined by Parameter.{i}.SampleMode , during the sample interval. The statistics values in this comma-separated list MUST be in time order, with the oldest one first and the most recent one last. If the Parameter.{i}.SampleMode parameter is not present, or is inappropriate for the referenced parameter, the statistics values MUST be collected in Current mode.

output.name: SampleSeconds
output.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers. Each entry indicates the number of seconds during which data was collected for this parameter during the sample interval. Individual SampleSeconds values can be less than SampleInterval , for several reasons, including: Any of the reasons for which SampleSeconds values might be less than SampleInterval . The parameter doesn't exist, or was created or deleted during a sample interval.

output.name: SuspectData
output.desc: Comma-separated list of unsigned integers (up to 1). Each entry is 0 if the sampled value is believed to be valid, or 1 if an event that might affect the validity of the sampled value occurred during the sample interval. For example, if the parameter value were to be reset during the sample interval then it would be appropriate to set SuspectData to 1.

output.name: Failures

The states are defined as follows: "in range" : current value is greater than Parameter.{i}.LowThreshold and less than Parameter.{i}.HighThreshold . "out of range" : current value is less than or equal to P...

events.name: Push!

events.name: DUStateChange!
events.desc: This event informs a Controller of the completion (successful or unsuccessful) of a Deployment Unit state change. When used, this event MUST be issued after the device has completed any file transfers and carried out all operations related to the Deployment Unit State Change. This event MAY contain the results from multiple Deployment Unit state changes; it is implementation specific how the device chooses to aggregate the Deployment Unit state changes, although the device MUST notify the Con...

output.name: UUID
output.desc: [ UUID ] The UUID as defined in [ RFC4122 ] of the Deployment Unit that affected by the state change.

output.name: DeploymentUnitRef
output.desc: The value MUST be the Path Name of a row in the DeploymentUnit. table. A reference to the Deployment Unit that was affected by the state change.

output.name: Version
output.desc: In the case of an Install, this will be the version of the Deployment Unit created. In the case of an Update, it will be the updated version of the Deployment Unit. In the case of an Uninstall, it will be the version of the uninstalled Deployment Unit. This MUST match the DeploymentUnit.{i}.Version Parameter contained within the instance of the Deployment Unit that is contained within the DeploymentUnitRef argument.

output.name: CurrentState
output.desc: The current state of the created Deployment Unit. Enumeration of: Installed (The Deployment Unit is in an Installed state due to one of the following: successful Install, successful Update, failed Update, or failed Uninstall. In the case of a failed Update or failed Uninstall the Fault argument will contain an explanation of the failure) UnInstalled (The Deployment Unit was successfully uninstalled from the device. This enumeration was DEPRECATED in 2.19 due to a typographical error in capita...

output.name: Resolved
output.desc: Whether or not the Deployment Unit operation resolved all of its dependencies. In the case of a successful Uninstall, this value is meaningless and should be true .

output.name: ExecutionUnitRefList
output.desc: Comma-separated list of strings. Each list item MUST be the Path Name of a row in the ExecutionUnit. table. The Execution Units affected by this operation. In the case of an Install, this will be the list of Execution Units that were created as a result of the Deployment Unit's installation. In the case of an Update, this will be the list of all Execution Units currently associated with the updated Deployment Unit, including those that were created through the initial Deployment Unit installa...

output.name: StartTime
output.desc: The date and time transfer was started in UTC. The device SHOULD record this information and report it in this argument, but if this information is not available, the value of this argument MUST be set to the Unknown Time value.

output.name: CompleteTime
output.desc: The date and time the transfer was fully completed and applied in UTC. This need only be filled in if the transfer has been fully completed and applied. The device SHOULD record this information and report it in this argument, but if this information is not available or the transfer has not completed, the value of this argument MUST be set to the Unknown Time value.

output.name: OperationPerformed
output.desc: The operation that was performed against the Deployment Unit causing the Deployment Unit state change. Enumeration of: Install (The operation attempted was the Installation of a Deployment Unit) Update (The operation attempted was the Update of an existing Deployment Unit) Uninstall (The operation attempted was the Un-Installation of an existing Deployment Unit)

output.name: Fault.
output.desc: Fault Structure. If the operation was successful, the FaultCode MUST be zero. Otherwise a non-zero FaultCode is specified along with a FaultString indicating the failure reason.

output.name: FaultCode
output.desc: The numerical fault code. Valid values are: If the operation was successful, the fault code is 0. If the device cannot complete the operation for some unknown reason, it SHOULD reject the operation with a 7002 (Request Denied) fault code. If the device detects the presence of the "userinfo" component in the file source URL, it SHOULD reject the operation with a 7004 (Invalid Arguments) fault code. If the device cannot find the Execution Environment specified in the Install or Update command, ...

output.name: FaultString
output.desc: A human-readable text description of the fault. This field SHOULD be empty if the FaultCode equals 0 (zero).

events.name: TransferComplete!
events.desc: Indicates that a file has been transferred to or from the Device. The event is sent when the transfer has either completed successfully (in which case FaultCode will be zero), or else has failed (in which case FaultCode will be non-zero and FaultString will give further details). The file transfer can be requested via a USP operation or via some other mechanism. If it's requested via a USP operation Command , CommandKey and Requestor give further details.

output.name: Command
output.desc: The Path Name of the command that requested the transfer, or an empty string if the transfer was not requested via a USP operation.

output.name: CommandKey
output.desc: The command_key supplied when requesting the transfer, or an empty string if the transfer was not requested via a USP operation. The default value MUST be an empty string.

output.name: Requestor
output.desc: The Endpoint ID of the Controller that requested the transfer, or an empty string if no Controller requested it. The default value MUST be an empty string.

output.name: TransferType
output.desc: The type (direction) of the transfer. Enumeration of: Download (Downstream transfer; to the Agent) Upload (Upstream transfer; from the Agent) The default value MUST be Download .

output.name: Affected
output.desc: The Path Name of the Object or Object Instance that was affected by the transfer, or an empty string if no data model object was affected by the transfer. The default value MUST be an empty string.

output.name: TransferURL
output.desc: The [ URL ] from or to which this transfer was performed, or an empty string if no such URL is available.

output.name: StartTime
output.desc: The date and time in UTC at which the transfer was started. The Device SHOULD record this information and report it in this argument, but if this information is not available, the value of this argument MUST be set to the Unknown Time value. The default value MUST be 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z .

output.name: CompleteTime
output.desc: The date and time in UTC at which the transfer was fully completed. This need only be filled in if the transfer has been fully completed. The Device SHOULD record this information and report it in this argument, but if this information is not available or the transfer has not completed, the value of this argument MUST be set to the Unknown Time value. The default value MUST be 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z .

output.name: FaultCode
output.desc: The numerical fault code as defined in [ TR-369 ]. A value of 0 (zero) indicates no fault. The default value MUST be 0 .

output.name: FaultString
output.desc: A human-readable text description of the fault. This field SHOULD be an empty string if the FaultCode equals 0 (zero). The default value MUST be an empty string.

output.name: CheckSumAlgorithm
output.desc: The hash algorithm that was used to generate the checksum for the transferred file. Enumeration of: SHA-1 (As specified in [ RFC3174 ]) SHA-224 (As specified in [ RFC6234 ]) SHA-256 (As specified in [ RFC6234 ]) SHA-384 (As specified in [ RFC6234 ]) SHA-512 (As specified in [ RFC6234 ]) Unknown (There was no algorithm specified for the transferred file)

output.name: CheckSum
output.desc: The hash value that was used for the transferred file. This hash value was generated using transferred file content and the CheckSumAlgorithm . If the argument is an empty string, not present, or the CheckSumAlgorithm is Unknown , then the Controller can assume that the checksum is not applicable or was not generated for this transfer.

events.name: Triggered!
events.desc: Triggered event requested via a Threshold object. The Triggered! will only be eligible for retriggering if the test condition is fulfilled again.

output.name: ParamPath

output.name: ParamValue
output.desc: The new ( ReferencePath and ThresholdParam ) Value.

events.desc: OnChange event requested via a Monitor object. When the values of the parameters specified by ReferenceList change within in the configured Interval , the agent MUST send an OnChange event.

output.name: ChangeSet.{i}.
output.desc: Each ChangeSet entry contains the changes for a monitored object. If multiple monitored objects change within the Interval , there will be multiple ChangeSet entries. When a parameter of an already included object changes multiple times within in the configured Interval . The parameter must be included in the ChangeSet instance, where the ObjectPath was previously used, and a new Parameter.{i} instance MUST be created. This table's Instance Numbers MUST be 1, 2, 3... (assigned sequentially wi...

output.name: ObjectPath
output.desc: Object path of the changed parameters.

output.name: ChangeSet.{i}.Parameter.{i}.
output.desc: OnChange parameter(s) table for the report sent by this event. This table contains entries for parameters whose values have been changed during the configured Interval . This table's Instance Numbers MUST be 1, 2, 3... (assigned sequentially without gaps). At most one entry in this table can exist with the same values for both Name and ChangeTime .

output.name: Name
output.desc: Name of the changed parameter.

output.name: Value
output.desc: New value of the parameter specified by Name .

output.name: OldValue
output.desc: Previous value of the parameter specified by Name .

output.name: ChangeTime
output.desc: The date and time when the parameter was changed in UTC, which MUST be specified to microsecond precision. For example: 2008-04-09T15:01:05.123456Z

events.desc: Watchdog event requested via a Watchdog object. When the RemainingTimerValue becomes 0 because the value of the Reference was not updated then the Watchdog Event will be invoked.

output.name: Reference
output.desc: The parameter Reference for which the Watchdog has been triggered.

output.name: ReloadTimerValue
output.desc: The ReloadTimerValue Value in seconds .

output.name: SeverityIndication
output.desc: The SeverityIndication Value.

events.name: USPGatewayDiscovered!
events.desc: Gateway discovery event indicating that the device discovered a compliant USP-enabled gateway. This event MAY be sent when the parameters are populated after a reboot or when the GatewayInfo has been updated.

output.name: EndpointID
output.desc: The unique USP identifier for this USP Agent.

events.name: CWMPGatewayDiscovered!
events.desc: Gateway discovery event indicating that the device discovered a compliant CWMP-enabled gateway. This event MAY be sent when the parameters are populated after a reboot or when the GatewayInfo has been updated.

output.name: ManufacturerOUI
output.desc: Organizationally unique identifier of the associated gateway. Possible patterns: <Empty> (an empty string) [0-9A-F]{6} an empty string indicates that there is no associated gateway that has been detected.

output.name: ProductClass
output.desc: Identifier of the product class of the associated gateway. An empty string indicates either that there is no associated gateway that has been detected, or the gateway does not support the use of the product-class parameter.

output.name: SerialNumber
output.desc: Serial number of the associated gateway. An empty string indicates that there is no associated gateway that has been detected.
